As part of our clients HR development and recruitment strategy, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition and HR Development Specialist to join their team. The selected candidate will be responsible for leading end-to-end recruitment processes and supporting training and development initiatives to ensure the attraction, integration, and retention of top talent.

Main Responsibilities :

Talent Acquisition

  • ﻿Collaborate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, job specifications, and requirements.

  • Develop and implement innovative recruitment strategies to attract high-quality candidates.

  • Source candidates using various channels, including job boards, social media, databases, and employee referrals.

  • Screen CVs and applications, conduct interviews, and assess candidates using appropriate selection tools.

  • Manage the hiring process: job offers, negotiation of terms, and onboarding of new employees.

  • Maintain accurate and updated recruitment data in the ATS.

  • Provide regular analytical reports and track hiring metrics.

  • Promote the companys employer brand and build positive candidate experiences.

Training and Development

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to assess training needs aligned with organizational goals.

  • Design and deliver effective learning programs using diverse methods (e-learning, classroom, virtual).

  • Facilitate training sessions and workshops for employees across all levels.

  • Evaluate training effectiveness and suggest improvements.

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts, trainers, and instructional designers to ensure high-quality content.

  • Monitor training KPIs and stay informed about learning and development best practices.

Profile Required

  • Degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field.

  • Proven experience in both recruitment and learning & development.

  • Strong knowledge of applicant tracking systems and HR metrics.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive, analytical, and adaptable mindset.

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus.

Technical Project Manager

Location: Remote

Multiple clients. Moving parts. You keep it all connected.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who can manage multiple client-facing projects simultaneously, keep technical teams aligned, and give clients confidence that their projects are in good hands.

You're comfortable discussing requirements with developers, translating technical details into plain English, and keeping scope, timelines, and priorities under control. You bring structure, communicate clearly, and address problems before they become surprises.

What You'll Do

  • Manage multiple client projects from discovery and kickoff through development, testing, launch, and handoff.
  • Serve as the primary project contact for clients, providing clear updates and setting realistic expectations.
  • Turn client goals into actionable requirements, project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate developers, designers, QA, and other stakeholders to keep work moving.
  • Track scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and dependencies across concurrent projects.
  • Identify risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate issues with recommended solutions.
  • Manage change requests and explain their impact on cost, timing, and delivery.
  • Lead productive kickoff meetings, sprint planning, status calls, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Partner with technical leads to ensure deliverables meet requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain clear documentation and improve processes as you learn what works.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience managing multiple client-facing technical projects at the same time.
  • A track record of delivering software, web, application, or technology implementation projects.
  • Working knowledge of software development lifecycles, Agile/Scrum, and traditional project management approaches.
  • Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, databases, and deployment requirements with technical teams.
  • Strong client communication skills, including the ability to navigate difficult conversations and competing priorities.
  • Excellent organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
  • Experience using tools such as Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
  • The ability to work independently and coordinate distributed teams in a remote environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a digital agency, software consultancy, or other environment serving multiple clients.
  • Experience with resource planning, project financials, or statements of work.
  • PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or a similar certification.

What Success Looks Like

Clients know where their projects stand. Teams understand what needs to happen next. Risks surface early, changes are handled thoughtfully, and projects reach the finish line with quality and accountability.

If you can connect the technical details, the client relationship, and the delivery plan, we'd love to hear from you.

Are you excited about working with cutting-edge network technologies?

Are you a developer who loves solving complex problems?

Join the Network Operations Systems Group

Our team develops innovative solutions crucial to deploying and maintaining Akamai's global network. Our network carries over 20% of the world's web traffic. We care about empowering Network Infrastructure, Operations and Engineering teams to work faster, reliably and more efficiently. We believe collaboration and continuous improvement lead to the best solutions.

Partner with the best

About us

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

As PMO Lead, you will be the engine of delivery discipline. You will bring structure, pace and clarity to a complex, matrixed environment and make sure what has been agreed actually gets done. You will work with Portfolio Strategy, regional teams, Finance, Legal, Workplace Services and external partners, and you will be the trusted voice on status, risks and savings for senior leaders. Portfolio Strategy and the regions define what should happen, and you make sure it is delivered.

What You'll Do

  • Own the master delivery plan for all agreed real estate opportunities, covering milestones, decision points, dependencies, approval timelines, critical lease events and benefits realisation dates
  • Run the programme rhythm through regular check-ins, action tracking, issue management and dependency reviews, and prepare senior leadership updates
  • Spot early what is late, blocked, missing or at risk, and make clear what action is needed
  • Maintain an integrated view of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and decisions across regions, JLL, Finance, Legal, Workplace Services, Portfolio Strategy and business stakeholders, and escalate early when delivery, approvals or savings are at risk
  • Own the single programme reporting view: progress against the $100m target, delivery by region, savings delivered and at risk, blockers, decisions required, escalations and upcoming approvals
  • Ensure consistent messaging to senior stakeholders and avoid multiple versions of the truth
  • Make sure every opportunity has a named owner, next action, due date, target saving, decision requirement, status and escalation route, and hold regions, JLL and internal teams to account without owning every action
  • Track which opportunities need business cases, confirm owners and submission dates, flag missing inputs and escalate delays, so cases are ready to enter the governance process

What We're Looking For

  • Strong programme and portfolio management capability, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-region programmes
  • Disciplined planning skills, including managing milestones, dependencies, critical paths and benefits realisation timelines
  • Sharp analytical and reporting skills, able to turn complex data into one clear, credible view for senior audiences
  • Confidence in risk, issue and dependency management (RAID) and in escalating early and constructively
  • Comfort operating in a matrix environment, influencing and driving follow-up without direct authority
  • Executive presence and the confidence to hold senior stakeholders and external partners to agreed actions
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management across functions, regions and cultures
  • A proactive, pace-driven mindset, with a bias for clarity, ownership and surfacing issues early

Scope Boundaries

The PMO Lead does not own portfolio strategy, opportunity identification, business case governance, finance validation or policy ownership. These accountabilities remain with the relevant functional owners.


What we offer:

Competitive Rewards & Benefits Permanent contract after probationary period, private healthcare, cafeteria system, life insurance, and employee assistance program

Flexible Work Environment Hybrid model in premium Warsaw Spire workspace with state-of-the-art facilities and metro access.

Career Development & Growth Robust development opportunities with 80% employee participation in structured programs, AI upskilling, and professional training.

Stability & Recognition 78% employee recommendation rate, recognized for 18 consecutive years as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies.

Inclusive & Supportive Culture Strong commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion across multiple employee resource groups and initiatives.

Global Perspective 60 nationalities and 40 languages represented, offering rich cultural exchange and collaboration opportunities.

Location:

Remote –Warsaw, POL

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.

JLL Privacy Notice

Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. Generally the personal information we collect from you are for the purposes of processing in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavour to keep your personal information secure with appropriate level of security and keep for as long as we need it for legitimate business or legal reasons. We will then delete it safely and securely.

For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view ourCandidate Privacy Statement.

For additional details please see our career site pages for each country.

About Gilytics

Gilytics is a Swiss geospatial SaaS company. Our platform, Pathfinder, helps utilities, grid operators and infrastructure planners find the best routes and sites for new infrastructure, turning months of manual planning into a data-driven, transparent process. We are a remote-first team of about 26 people across Europe and the Americas.

The role

We are looking for a Backend Lead to own the server-side engine behind Pathfinder: the geoprocessing, spatial data APIs and backend services our customers rely on. This is a hands-on senior role. Depth of knowledge and an ownership-driven, collaborative attitude matter more to us than years in a management title.

You will report to our CTO, Salvador Bayarri, and work closely with the Frontend, DevOps and GIS Data teams.

Tasks

What you will do

  • Architect and build the backend data model, REST APIs and services behind Pathfinder

  • Develop, optimise and maintain geoprocesses and spatial data functions

  • Set backend priorities with the CTO and run agile delivery for the team

  • Lead code reviews and set the standards for testing, documentation and security

  • Mentor and grow backend developers

  • Integrate AI into the backend (model endpoints, MCP servers, AI agents) and champion AI-assisted development across the team

  • Contribute to product roadmap planning and technical estimation

Requirements

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development, primarily backend

  • Strong Python, including GIS libraries such as GEOS, GDAL/OGR, Shapely or GeoPandas

  • Hands-on experience building geospatial applications with PostgreSQL/PostGIS

  • A track record of designing and maintaining REST APIs and scalable backend services

  • Technical leadership experience: coordinating developers, reviewing code and mentoring, whether or not you held a formal management title

  • Good knowledge of Git, automated testing and CI/CD

  • Professional working English

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, GIS/Geoinformatics or similar, or equivalent professional experience

Nice to have

  • Django / Django REST Framework

  • Geoprocessing pipelines at scale and large spatial datasets

  • AWS, Docker, Linux

  • Scrum or other agile delivery experience

  • Some proven experience applying AI or GeoAI in a product

Benefits

What we offer

  • Real ownership of the technical core of a product used by major utilities and grid operators

  • Work that matters: Pathfinder helps speed up the infrastructure behind the energy transition

  • Flexible hours around CET core time (10:00–15:00), and a choice of hybrid in Valencia or fully remote in Europe

  • A small, senior, international team where your decisions ship

  • An AI-forward engineering culture, with tooling and time to use it

Note> Please submit your application in english, applications submitted in other languages will be disregarded

raw.description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

  • Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
  • Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
  • Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

SmithRx is seeking a Pricing & Forecasting Leader to join our growing team. In this strategic leadership role, you'll collaborate directly with senior executives and our key clients to ensure that SmithRx is achieving our objective of providing the lowest possible drug costs. This individual will be responsible for leading the Pricing team in support of crafting winning PBM offers. The Pricing team supports all pricing activity, for both new opportunities and retention opportunities, for employer groups of all sizes and industries. This role will collaborate closely with our Sales team and Proposals team, as well as our Strategy, Consultant Relations, Partnerships, Legal,Supply Chain, and Account Management teams and be a critical driver of SmithRx’s growth. In addition, this role will be responsible for architecting Smith’s strategy enhanced forecast analytics at both the customer and market levels, with an emphasis on influence on its impact on pricing offers and guarantees. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in pricing & underwriting, as well as forecasting and analytics. They will possess a balance in connecting analytical detail, market trends, and clinical information to develop an overall cohesive pricing approach.

What you will do:

  • Lead the Smith Pricing team, which is responsible for the pricing and guarantees submitted for all proposals.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team to adapt and refine pricing offers to best suit the needs of prospects and enable SmithRx to win.
  • Own the development, maintenance, and execution of forward-looking drug spend forecasting models.
  • Engage pharmacy consultants and brokers to educate the market about SmithRx’s market trend expectations and how Smith manages to optimize client outcomes against trend.
  • Work closely with Sales and Proposals teams to craft offers to pharmacy consultants, brokers, and clients which properly reflect SmithRx’s value.
  • Compose offers that employers understand and find compelling.
  • Generate pricing and related answers to be entered into RFP platforms.
  • Partner with Strategy, Supply Chain, and Clinical to develop next generation pricing models for Pharmacy Benefits.
  • Partner with the Clinical Strategy team to translate upcoming pharmacy market events into quantitative financial models, and quantify the impact of macro-market shifts.
  • Evaluate customer level trends, to identify key drivers and inform future expectations at the overall spend levels.
  • Translate highly complex actuarial and analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives for executive leadership, consultants, and sophisticated employer groups.
  • Direct the creation of external trend reports showcasing the Smith’s market expectations and cost-containment efficacy.
  • Work with the Data Analytics team to build out model(s) for deeply understanding drug spend forecasts, and build reports to maximally automate the process of spend forecasting given customer specific trends.
  • Actively participate in customer level assessment for ongoing new opportunities and retention activity.
  • Various other ad hoc strategic projects aimed supporting SmithRx growth initiatives.

What you will bring to SmithRx:

  • 10+ years of experience in analytical, forecasting, financial, actuarial or strategy roles, including 5+ years experience in healthcare and/or pharmacy industry related roles
  • Prior experience at PBM or Pharmacy Consulting is preferred
  • Experience working with historical claims data to assess and manage risk by conducting reprice and trend analyses
  • Strong familiarity with pharmacy industry dynamics and major market events
  • Experience with leading conversations with employers, brokers and pharmacy benefits consultants regarding pharmacy benefits
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, advanced degree or MBA preferred
  • You have a proven track record of delivering exceptional, quantifiable business impact
  • You have experience in a highly strategic, analytical and operational role in fast-paced environments
  • You are low ego and have a knack for working well with a wide range of people
  • You excel at using data to reach decisions and are comfortable demonstrating these skills to external stakeholders
  • Excel at both written and oral communication, adeptly presenting SmithRx trend expectations with a deep level of rigor to audiences including internal leaders, brokers, pharmacy consultants, and employers

What SmithRx Offers You:

  • Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Program
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Wellness Benefits
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Paid Parental Leave benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Well-stocked kitchen in office locations
  • Professional development and training opportunities

raw.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Communications, Culture & Development team helps Upstarters understand where the company is going, feel connected to its purpose, and build the capabilities they need to do their best work. We partner across the People Team and the business to create clear, effective employee experiences at important moments throughout the year.

As the People Programs Manager at Upstart, you will lead end-to-end program management for some of our most visible employee programs, including our mid-year and year-end performance review cycles, Pulse, and AI Acceleration work. You’ll bring structure and momentum to complex, cross-functional initiatives, translate program direction into practical plans, and ensure decisions turn into coordinated, high-quality execution.

This is a hands-on role for a strong operator who can see around corners, create clarity in ambiguity, and move comfortably between the larger purpose of a program and the details required to deliver it well.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead the planning and delivery of Upstart’s mid-year and year-end performance review cycles, coordinating timelines, systems readiness, communications, stakeholder inputs, launch activities, and cross-functional dependencies to create a clear and effective experience for Upstarters and managers.
  • Manage the Pulse program in partnership with People Analytics, HRBPs, and senior leaders, coordinating survey readiness, launch, response tracking, results distribution, action-planning logistics, and follow-through.
  • Serve as the central program manager for AI Acceleration, translating executive direction into coordinated workstreams, milestones, decision points, and measurable progress.
  • Partner across Internal Communications, Learning and Development, Technology, and the broader People Team to support employee-facing AI adoption, communications, enablement, experimentation, and change management.
  • Create integrated program plans and operating rhythms that establish clear ownership, surface dependencies and risks, support timely decisions, and keep cross-functional partners moving toward shared outcomes.
  • Continuously improve the systems, playbooks, and processes behind each program, using employee feedback, program data, and lessons learned to make future cycles more coordinated, measurable, and effective.
  • Support additional high-priority, nontechnical People programs as capacity and business needs allow.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in People or HR programs, employee experience, enterprise program management, organizational change, internal communications, or a related field.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, milestones, and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing at least one enterprise People program, such as performance management, employee listening, AI or technology adoption, change management, or another company-wide employee initiative.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate broad direction into integrated workplans, clear ownership, decision points, and coordinated execution.
  • Experience using quantitative and qualitative data to measure program effectiveness and inform practical improvements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear, concise, executive-ready updates and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority and create accountability across teams, functions, and levels.
  • A hands-on working style and willingness to own both strategic coordination and detailed final-mile execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting performance review cycles, employee listening or engagement surveys, AI adoption, or enterprise change initiatives.
  • Experience supporting employee adoption or behavior change related to AI, technology, or new ways of working.
  • Ability to translate employee feedback, program data, and lessons learned into clear recommendations and practical improvements.
  • Familiarity with employee survey platforms, performance management systems, project-management tools, or modern knowledge and collaboration platforms.
  • Demonstrated fluency with GenAI tools and an interest in helping organizations adopt AI thoughtfully and effectively.
  • Experience working in a remote-first, technology, fintech, rapidly evolving, or regulated environment.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$138,000—$200,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional PMHNPs operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced psychiatrists through consults and peer case reviews.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for PMHNPs who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered PMHNPs to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Collaborating Physician Coverage: Where applicable, we provide your collaborating psychiatrist and fully cover the costs.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented PMHNPs and psychiatrists in the world. Our current PMHNPs have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions, including Vanderbilt, UT Austin, Johns Hopkins, Columbia, NYU, and UTHealth Houston.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and clinical peers through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted state-issued authority to practice as a PMHNP in at least one U.S. state or jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Compensation: $150K–$300K per year, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our Clinical Advisory Board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based PMHNP who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation Range: $150K - $300K

Why you should join us

Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

About this role

We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth.

We’re looking for 2-3 Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch).

Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational complexity, its own customer personas and painpoints, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to take ownership of one of these new bets.

Why you will (or won't) like working here

  • 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.

  • Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve.

  • Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.

What you'll own

There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team.

The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works.

Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling.

Who you are

  • A first-principles thinker: You approach problems with curiosity and use data to develop clear hypotheses before you reach for a solution. You're analytically strong but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

  • Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

  • Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup

  • Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams

  • Comfort with data: able to run your own analysis and build conviction from messy signals

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational complexity, its own customer personas and painpoints, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to take ownership of one of these new bets.

Why you will (or won't) like working here

  • 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.

  • Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve.

  • Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.

What you'll own

There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team.

The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works.

Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling.

Who you are

  • A first-principles thinker: You approach problems with curiosity and use data to develop clear hypotheses before you reach for a solution. You're analytically strong but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

  • Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

  • Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup

  • Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams

  • Comfort with data: able to run your own analysis and build conviction from messy signals

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Account Executive to win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will own the commercial outcome, from pipeline creation to close, by practicing insight-led selling: reframing the customer's initial problem, quantifying the cost of inaction, and mobilizing buying committees around a compelling "why now."

You'll lead multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles with CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement leadership, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to run disciplined deal plans, deliver value-based proposals, and land enterprise rollouts.

What you'll own

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

  • Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. Strong differentiation and real enterprise proof points.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Employee-owned company; choose annually to take variable compensation in cash or shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your path in a rapidly scaling, international company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding plus ongoing coaching.

  • Exceptional team. Ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to excellence.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

The Martech team enables Marketing to scale through connected platforms, reliable data, automated processes, and technology solutions that support lead management, CRM processes, campaign execution, reporting, and revenue growth.

As a Data Product Manager, Marketing Technology, you will define and deliver Martech capabilities with an initial focus on owning end-to-end lead flow, lead validation and enriching processes, Marketing data integrations, and platform optimizations and consolidations. You will partner across Marketing, IT, Digital, and Data teams to translate business needs into clear requirements, prioritize enhancements, and drive scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Act as the data product owner and advocate for Marketing stakeholders, gathering feedback, identifying pain points, and translating needs into Martech capabilities and enhancements.

  • Develop, own, and manage clear business requirements for Martech initiatives, including lead management, lead processing analysis and reporting, system integrations, data quality enhancements, and operational workflows.

  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand Martech platform capabilities, system roadmaps, integration dependencies, customization needs, and implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle, including roadmap planning, discovery, requirements definition, sprint planning, product reviews, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch optimization.

  • Identify, prioritize, and document business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.

  • Prepare current-state and future-state process documentation, system workflows, training materials, and gap analyses to support business alignment and change management.

  • Define and track desired outcomes, OKRs, KPIs, and adoption metrics to measure the success of Martech initiatives.

  • Lead or support stakeholder alignment, including obtaining cross-functional sign-off on requirements, solution design, UAT readiness, and release decisions.

  • Define test criteria, support User Acceptance Testing, validate business outcomes, and help determine project readiness for launch.

  • Troubleshoot data, lead flow, integration, and process issues across Martech platforms, marketing automation systems, and related third-party tools.

  • Serve as a Martech subject matter expert across key platforms such as CRM platforms, Marketo, Adobe Experience Platform, ServiceNow, Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager, or other relevant marketing and sales technology tools.

  • Support M&A integration efforts by assisting with discovery, documentation, and requirements for acquired system onboarding.

  • Partner with global and regional marketing teams to improve communication, adoption, governance, and consistency across Martech processes.

  • Contribute to retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual work, improve data integrity, and increase marketing efficiency.

  • Help maintain Martech governance standards, including documentation, intake processes, prioritization models, release communications, and operational best practices.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, business product management, marketing technology, marketing operations, CRM, marketing automation, or a related function.

  • Proven experience partnering with Marketing, Sales, IT, Data, and other cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve marketing technology solutions.

  • Strong experience with Marketing automation systems and data platforms

  • Experience working with Martech integrations, third-party tools, data flows, APIs, lead management processes, campaign operations, or customer data platforms.

  • Adobe Experience Platform experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience defining business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process documentation.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management, OKRs, and KPI measurement.

  • Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, stakeholder sign-off, and change management.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate system, data, and process issues.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence, align, and communicate with stakeholders at multiple levels.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and cross-functional dependencies simultaneously.

  • Experience with data quality, database structures, data cleansing, data enrichment, segmentation, or reporting processes preferred

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and high stakeholder visibility.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with enterprise Martech ecosystems and platforms such as CRM platforms, Marketo, Adobe Experience Platform, ServiceNow, Workfront, ZoomInfo, Demandbase, 6sense, or similar tools.

  • Experience supporting lead lifecycle management, routing, scoring, attribution, campaign execution, personalization, or buying group processes.

  • Familiarity with marketing data governance, consent management, privacy requirements, and operational compliance.

  • Ability to run SQL queries against data warehouses analyzing large datasets for areas of optimization

  • Experience creating enablement materials, training documentation, release notes, and stakeholder communications.

  • Prior experience in a global marketing organization or enterprise B2B environment.

raw.description:
Sartorius has a position for a Field Account Manager, candidates for this remote based position will be responsible for all sales results of mid-size and large accounts in a defined territory and for developing strong customer relations according to the organizational strategy for the assigned customer base. An essential part of this role is the active use of our CRM system (SFDC) to manage sales activities and customer interactions effectively as this tool is the foundation of our sales framework and operational sales steering, and a key enabler for this role to achieve his/her targets as well as Sartorius targets.

What you will accomplish together with us:


  • Promote the organization's products and services within an assigned geographic area, product range or key account to achieve sales and revenue targets
  • Identify new business opportunities aligned with the organization's overall market and growth strategy
  • Actively use SFDC to manage and document leads and opportunities, all customer interactions and sales activities ensuring that all customer and opportunity information is up-to-date and accurately entered in the CRM system
  • Analyze SFDC data for assigned customers to identify trends, generate customer insights and track sales performance
  • Actively drive newly launched innovative products and services into the marketplace and proactively follow up on the successful implementation of sales activity
  • Assess and analyze customer needs, generate leads, respond to customer inquiries and suggest products and services as appropriate
  • Develop and implement account plans and request and coordinate resources in line with the account plans
  • Work closely with cross functional team to create higher market perception and successful strategies to gain business from an account
  • Coordinate and participate in marketing activities in assigned territory
  • Frequently assess the potential of each customer and plan to realize it into business
  • Manage and build strong customer relationships for long term partnership

What will convince us:

  • Bachelors degree in life sciences, engineering or a related field (higher level of education would be beneficial)
  • 3+ years field sales experience, with preferable laboratory/process-based experience in Life Science
  • Hands-on knowledge and proactive usage of SFDC and other CRM tools
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Self-motivated, energetic, results oriented, capacity to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility
  • Good teamwork skills and proven ability to also work with cross-functional teams
  • Living in Rio de Janeiro
  • Experience with Fiocruz is required
  • Availability to travel frequently (50% of the time)
  • Proven software skills, e.g. Microsoft Office
  • Identification with our core values: Sustainability, Openness, Enjoyment

About Sartorius

Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide.

We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.

Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.

Job Title: Community Development Manager, Central (KY, TN, MS, AL)

Location: USRemote - Nashville, TN

About the Job:

The Community Development Manager will play a critical role in driving sales, optimizing care pathways for of cross-lysosomal storage disease patients, and ensuring formulary access to enhance patient outcomes and achieve organizational goals.

The Community Development Manager will be responsible for growing and expanding the rare disease business in their respective region. They must possess a high level of product, clinical and customer knowledge, be familiar with protocols and procedures, as well as possess an entrepreneurial spirit to lead and grow their business.

The Community Development Manager will not only cultivate existing business but will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities via lead/trigger follow-up. This role will report to the Strategic Account Director, Central – Pinwheel Galaxy.

The Community Development Manager will engage community prescribers but also generate a key source of growth which is using digital leads to find undiagnosed patients and or educating prescribers to refer diagnosed untreated patients. Work with the SAD in the co-creation of customer value account plans and clear execution metrics.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for 5 therapeutic areas, 7 brands and building and gaining approval for account specific plans.
  • Makes decisions and build plans with a combined business and scientific mindset.
  • Achieve and exceed patient sales targets.
  • Build and execute against clear account plans.
  • Cultivate and maintain a diverse network of relationships with healthcare providers, demonstrating adaptability and enthusiasm for engaging with a wide variety of contacts and activities.
  • Educate targeted healthcare providers on the benefits of the full portfolio of Sanofi RD therapies.
  • Develop and communicate deep scientific understanding of xLSDs and Sanofi offerings.
  • Build awareness of signs and symptoms of xLSD diseases (incl., family trees).
  • Educate on the proper diagnosis pathway, diagnostic tests, and free testing programs.
  • Communicate the clinical benefits, efficacy, and safety value proposition of Sanofi’s products.
  • Educate on product administration, expectations of treatment and the importance of adherence and compliance.
  • Support referral network: encourage referrals to “right” specialists to manage treatment of LSD.
  • Effectively convey complex clinical and reimbursement product information to key stakeholders in a highly competitive marketplace.
  • Collaborate effectively with Sanofi team members within and across functions.
  • Travel as needed to assigned accounts and regions to meet with key stakeholders.

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 5 years pharmaceutical sales experience with proven results (preferably in rare diseases or specialized therapeutic areas)
  • Strategic sales thinker with the ability to analyze complex market situations and develop innovative solutions to drive sales and optimize care.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal skills, and executive presence
  • Digital literacy and digital-first mindset
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with key stakeholders
  • Resourceful and skilled at prospecting

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

This position is eligible for a company car through the Company’s FLEET program.

Candidates must complete all fleet safety training and must maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

raw.description:
Position: Head of Upper School (HOUS)

Reports to: Head of Academics and Student Affairs, and Head of School

Salary: $115,000

Direct Reports:

  • Heads of Department (in coordination with the Director of Curriculum & Instruction)

Position Overview

The Head of Upper School (HOUS) is responsible for overseeing the Upper School program (Grades 9–12) at Dwight Global, with the ultimate goal of achieving Dwight Global’s mission of igniting the spark of genius in every child. The HOUS works and collaborates with a team, including the Upper School Deans, Curriculum & Instruction, Heads of Department, the Dean of Student Life, the IB DP Coordinator, and Upper School faculty members, as well as with administrators and faculty members within The Dwight Schools worldwide network.

This position is remote; the Head of Upper School should anticipate travel to New York City a few times each year.

Responsibilities of the Position

Academic Department Support and Supervision

  • Work with the Head of Academics and Student Affairs and the Director of Curriculum & Instruction, overseeing the recruiting, hiring, evaluation, and supervision of faculty (Grades 9–12).
  • Collaborate with the Curriculum & Instruction team to oversee the creation, implementation, and ongoing development of the Upper School curriculum, ensuring rigor, innovation, and alignment with school-wide standards.
  • Oversee and develop Division and Grade Level meetings that incorporate vertical, horizontal, pastoral, and departmental planning.
  • Address and coordinate scheduling and staffing for unique student situations (new class sections, personalized classes, independent studies, etc.).

Pastoral Care, Student Discipline, and Deans

  • Work with the Associate Head of Academics and Student Affairs to oversee the Upper Deans
  • With the Deans, build a healthy school culture through assemblies, advisories, and other programs that promote belonging, integrity, and leadership.
  • Oversee creation and continued improvement of the Upper School Orientation course and parent education programs
  • Cultivate an Upper School school culture that values academic honesty, intellectual curiosity, and ethical decision-making. Develop and implement clear expectations and practices around academic integrity, ensuring that students understand the importance of original work, responsible scholarship, and accountability.
  • Coordinate Honor Council to maintain fairness, transparency, and integrity across all academic and behavioral processes.
  • Manage and implement online proctoring review and disciplinary process for academic honesty infractions
  • Manage summer grade recovery process for Upper School students

College Counseling and Post-Secondary Planning

  • Collaborate with the Associate Head of Academics and Student Affairs and Director of College Counseling to ensure that each student in Grades 9–12 receives personalized and developmentally appropriate guidance.
  • Oversee integration of academic advising and college counseling through joint meetings, workshops, and parent sessions.
  • Support the implementation of standardized testing, college readiness programming, and family information sessions.

Accommodations/Quest

  • Work with the Head of Quest and Learning Support to oversee accommodations and ensure support for students with learning needs in Grades 9–12.
  • Ensure that Quest plans are implemented consistently across academic departments and that faculty are equipped to support students with approved accommodations.

School Authorization and Accreditation

  • Work in conjunction with the Head of Academics and Student Affairs on all school accreditation and authorization processes (Cognia, IB, etc.).
  • Provide evidence, documentation, and data as required for accreditation and program evaluations related to Grades 9–12.

Other Responsibilities

  • Work with the Scheduler to develop the Upper School Schedule.
  • Update the Head of School, Head of Academics and Student Affairs regularly on all significant issues in each area of the school under their supervision.
  • Participate in admissions programs as needed (e.g., open houses, student interviews, committee reviews).
  • Participate in cross-campus projects and worldwide Dwight-Franklin collaborations.

Data Analysis

  • With the Curriculum & Instruction team, review all Upper School assessment data (internal and external), including AP, IB, PSAT, and other performance indicators.
  • Ensure that data informs curriculum development, personalized learning strategies, and student success planning.
  • Work with Heads of Department to use data for reflection, goal-setting, and instructional improvement.
