raw.title: Elite AI Agent Engineer- B2B Lead Generation & Automation
raw.excerpt: PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation.
raw.description:
PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation.

You must have personally architected, built, deployed, and operated AI agents that generate measurable B2B prospecting results.

We’re seeking an AI engineer who can build the intelligence behind the system

AI agents that use tools, make decisions, coordinate workflows, and turn enterprise buying signals into qualified sales meetings.

If you are an expert at building AI agents for B2B lead generation and can prove they work, we want to meet you.

About PlanITROI

25 years of success. Global industry recognition. Founder-led. No corporate red tape. An ambitious future powered by AI and Robotics!

For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped enterprise organizations maximize the financial value of retired technology through IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner’s ITAD Market Guide, is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor, and has built our business around reuse-as-intended-use, prioritizing reuse over recycling.

Our mission: Maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients, reduces unnecessary electronic waste, and gives technology a second life as affordable technology.

Why you’ll love working here

Founder-led. Move fast. Get things done. Work directly with entrepreneurial leadership. No layers of corporate bureaucracy or endless approval cycles. Great ideas get heard, tested, and implemented.

Built like an AI startup, backed by an established company. Bring your engineering ideas to a business with 25 years of enterprise relationships, operating experience, and real market opportunities.

Engineer something big. Build AI agents capable of researching 5,000+ enterprise accounts, identifying buying signals, reaching 250,000+ potential right contacts, and generating qualified meetings at scale.

See measurable results. Your agents will directly influence enterprise revenue and help more technology get repaired, reused, and returned to productive use.

Work with people who value builders. We believe in optimism, discipline, humility, ownership, continuous improvement, and recognizing teammates who help others succeed.

Your mission: Build an intelligent AI-powered lead generation engine

Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve an interconnected system of specialized AI agents that identifies enterprise buying opportunities and converts them into qualified meetings. You will own the technical outbound engine end to end, from buying-signal detection and account intelligence to contact discovery, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. Our target market (ICP) includes enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 1,000,000+ employees, 80%+ mostly knowledge workers with complex buying committees, and existing technology providers. Your challenge is to find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and create a compelling reason to engage in PlanITROI.

This role reports to the Founder & CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer. You’ll work directly with them and the VP of Marketing, with no layers in between.

Your goal: Qualified enterprise meetings generated and MSA’s signed!

What you will build and own

  • AI Intent Signal Detection Agents. Identify, ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals, including technology refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, technology initiatives, and social activity. Trigger the right next action.
  • AI Buying Committee Intelligence Agents. Identify high-value ICP accounts, research enterprise organizations, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts for each entry point, validate contact information, and continuously track changes.
  • AI Personalization & Challenger Messaging Agents. Combine account intelligence, buying signals, persona-specific pain points, account history, and incumbent-provider context to create relevant, personalized outreach at scale.
  • AI Multichannel Orchestration Agents. Coordinate email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR/BDR follow-up. Manage sequencing, timing, channel rules, routing, and next-best actions.
  • AI Objection Handling & Follow-Up Agents. Recognize and respond intelligently to objections such as “We already have a provider.” Maintain conversational context, determine appropriate follow-up, and escalate to humans when needed.
  • AI Performance & Optimization Agents. Measure results across signals, personas, channels, and campaigns. Identify winning and losing hypotheses, recommend experiments, and improve qualified meeting conversion.

These are functional capabilities, not a requirement to deploy six separate agents. You will design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together.

Non-negotiable technical requirements: This role requires a hands-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself. If you qualify, we’ll give you a real project to prove it. You’ll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay. Using them isn’t the role; building the agents that run on top of them is.

We are seeking proven hands-on expertise in:

  • AI agent engineering: LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, agent memory, state management, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Agent frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable frameworks.
  • Software development: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, custom integrations, and automation architecture.
  • GTM integrations: Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, Bombora-type intent sources, and AI calling/voicemail platforms.
  • Enterprise prospecting: Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying-committee identification, contact resolution, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design.
  • Production operations: Agent monitoring, debugging, data quality, CRM synchronization, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, error handling, and auditability.
  • Scale: Engineering reliable systems capable of very high outbound volumes, reaching 250,000+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail, while protecting platform limits, accuracy, compliance, and deliverability.

You must understand both the technical engineering and the B2B prospecting strategy required to turn agents into a functioning revenue system.

What success looks like

  • Qualified meetings generated: Your primary business outcome. Meetings must satisfy defined ICP, persona, and business-need criteria.
  • Signal-to-meeting conversion: How effectively your agents convert meaningful buying signals into conversations and qualified meetings.
  • Contact Precision: Reaching the right decision-makers and buying committees.
  • Agent deployment velocity: How quickly you turn a campaign idea into a reliable, working agent and live test.
  • Multichannel conversion: Positive responses, conversations, qualified meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign.
  • System reliability: Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, compliance, and scalability.
  • Learning rate: How quickly do you identify what isn’t working, fix root causes, and scale what produces results.

Our hiring process: Show me, don’t tell me

We hire proof, not interviews alone. We’re not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished presentations about what agents might do.

The process has three stages:

  • Live demo. Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced.
  • Build a project. Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools.
  • Live technical session. Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture.

Across these stages, be ready to show:

  • Your agent architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, data integrations, and orchestration.
  • How your agents identify opportunities and execute prospecting workflows.
  • How do your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human intervention?
  • Real performance data: qualified meetings, pipelines, conversions, or measurable improvements your systems produced.

Ready for the challenge?

If you love solving difficult technical problems and want to build something ambitious, PlanITROI is where you can make an impact. Bring your engineering expertise, working agents, ideas, and your drive to succeed. We’ll bring 25 years of industry experience, enterprise relationships, a substantial market opportunity, and the ability to move fast.

Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.

PlanITROI offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization.

Learn more: PlanITROI.com | NextraTech.com | DigitalDreamsProject.com

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contractTesting Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care.

The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply.

Key responsibilities:

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

Requirements:

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra + Bend network:

  • Connect with highly compatible clients who are a good fit for your clinical expertise

  • Set your own schedule, without a minimum hours requirement

  • Access to cutting edge technology and a team of support staff (e.g., psychometrists, psychometrist assistants) to help ease the administrative burden of the evaluation process
  • Testing supplies are provided for you

raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc.) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring an AR & Billing Specialist to join the Finance team. You’ll own billing, collections, accounts payable, creator payments, and cash visibility across more than 80 client accounts and around 100 invoices a month. You’ll report to the SVP of Finance and work closely with the Finance Operations Manager, who sets our collections strategy, as well as our account leads and external bookkeeper.

This is not a reminder-sending role. We want someone who knows every account, spots payment risk early, and decides how to approach each client so we get paid on time without damaging the relationship.

This role is built for someone who sees AI as a core part of how finance gets done. You’ll use tools like Claude to check calculations, automate repetitive billing and follow-up work, and build workflows that raise both the speed and accuracy of our output.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare and issue all client invoices each cycle, including recurring retainers, one-off projects, variable and performance fees, and hourly web-support work.

  • Reconcile tracked hours and variable-fee calculations against contracts and scopes before invoices go out.

  • Keep the billing schedule current as clients start, change scope, pause, or offboard.

  • Own collections execution end to end: run the follow-up calendar, manage AR aging and days sales outstanding, and follow the collections strategy set for each account.

  • Carry out the approach set for each account, such as one consolidated reminder before the due date, a call with the client’s finance team, or bringing in the account lead, and recommend changes when an approach isn’t working.

  • Join the daily cash flow check-in led by the Finance Operations Manager.

  • Flag at-risk accounts early, such as slipping payment patterns, disputes, or unresponsive contacts, with a recommended action.

  • Prepare the weekly cash and AR report, and draft the cash and collections section of the monthly report.

  • Keep the weekly cash forecast current, with expected receipts by client and by week.

  • Run accounts payable in Ramp: enter vendor bills, check them against approvals and contracts, schedule payments, and keep vendor records current.

  • Pay creators, partners, and referral payouts in Ramp once amounts are approved, and keep payee records current.

  • Record invoices and payments in QuickBooks, working alongside our external bookkeeper.

  • Peer-check teammates’ work, such as reported MRR and client data against billing records.

  • Maintain and improve our collections playbook and billing processes.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • You have 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, billing, or collections, ideally at an agency, professional services, or SaaS company with US clients.

  • You have hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online. Experience with Ramp or a similar AP tool is a plus.

  • You’re strong in Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliations.

  • You have a high bar for accuracy. Invoices you send are right the first time.

  • You’re a confident communicator, polite but firm with US client contacts, by email and on calls.

  • You have good judgment about people and priorities. You know when to push, when to escalate, and when to wait.

  • You take initiative. You raise problems together with a proposed fix instead of waiting to be told.

  • You use Claude or similar AI tools in your work, or you’re eager to.

  • You’re fluent in written and spoken English.

What It’s Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape, just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + local holidays (relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT. We are a global digital engineering, product development, and technology consulting company. Headquartered in New York, we have a team of 1000+ experts working across 65+ countries.

About this job:
We are seeking an architecture-level engineer to serve as a primary designer and developer on our Databricks Platform Modernization initiative. This role spans medallion architecture, greenfield build-out, data quality processes, cross-team UAT enablement, and AI/ML use case delivery.

Location: LATAM (remote)

How you'll make an impact:
· Greenfield architecture — medallion architecture (silver/gold), entity relationship model, and data contracts; includes but is not limited to standardization, cleansing, deduplication, and merge logic; ensuring that Databricks best practices and internal Enterprise Architecture processes are followed;
· Environment promotion — dev QA prod promotion lane, including deployment-pipeline enabler work;
· UAT enablement — active fix-it engineer supporting Genie/dashboard UAT test cycles;
· Cross-domain platform contribution — commit directly to the shared, reusable Databricks platform template (consumed by multiple domains);
· Release governance — operate within a formal, peer-reviewed promotion model where production releases require an approved change ticket, reflecting comfort with enterprise change-control process, not just technical delivery;
· Knowledge transfer — provide ongoing knowledge transfer, assist teams as they upskill and begin to take over work, and ensure appropriate documentation is available for future onboarding;
· Security-conscious automation design — design least-privilege automation (e.g., scoped bot credentials limited to a single target repository, validated with an explicit smoke test) rather than broad-access shortcuts;
· AI/ML platform enablement — partner with Enterprise Architecture and ML teams to design feature pipelines, model-serving architecture, and governance of ML artifacts (models, features, vector indexes);
· GenAI capability evaluation — assess and pilot new GenAI/agentic capabilities (e.g., Claude-based tooling, agent frameworks) for data engineering and semantic-layer workflows before wider adoption.

What makes you a great fit:
· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field;
· 10+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture roles;
· 4+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks;
· Experience with the insurance industry (Nice to have);
· Strong knowledge of AWS cloud platforms;
· Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted development tools.

Core platform skills:
· Delta Lake medallion architecture (bronze silver gold platinum) and Unity Catalog schema/metric-view design;
· Databricks Asset Bundles for CI/CD-style promotion across dev/QA/prod environments;
· Databricks Jobs orchestration and freshness/volume monitoring design — building alerting tables and configuration from scratch, not just consuming existing ones;
· Data quality framework design — DataPact contracts and DQX checks;
· AI/BI enablement — Genie space configuration/semantics (including multi-environment automation) and Lakeview dashboard build and defect resolution;
· CI/CD and release engineering — GitHub Actions-based promotion pipelines (PR - gated dev - QA - prod), Databricks Asset Bundle validation gates, and OIDC-based cloud authentication in place of long-lived secrets;
· Data reconciliation engineering — designing formal, machine-checked contracts for data conservation and cross-system parity (e.g., versioned-state recovery, parity-witness scoping) rather than one-off reconciliation scripts;
· AI/ML platform architecture — designing Unity Catalog-governed feature tables and ML-ready gold/platinum layers, and integrating MLflow experiment tracking and model registry into the platform's existing promotion model;
· GenAI/LLM enablement on Databricks — architecting vector search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, model-serving endpoints, and extending the existing Genie AI/BI semantic layer toward broader GenAI use cases;
· AI-assisted engineering practices — using Claude and other AI coding/review tooling as part of the build and review workflow, consistent with platform best practices.

Other skills:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English;
    · Ability to work in a global, multi-national company;
    · Ability to lead conversations with both technical and business representatives;
    · Proven ability to work both independently and as a part of an international project team.

If you're looking to contribute to global projects, grow your skills, shape the way you work, and be part of a connected international community — Customertimes is the place to build your next career chapter. Are you ready to spark the tech with us?

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. Our mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives extends beyond borders. Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing. Our retail partners need Affirm to be there for them, wherever that might be. To help achieve this vision, we are expanding our product lines and becoming a global company.

The International Consumer product team is responsible for building and scaling Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and experiences across international markets. This includes our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related offerings that help consumers discover, use, and manage Affirm.

As a Senior Product Manager on the International Consumer team, you will drive the strategy, execution, and growth of Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products across international markets – from iterating on the product vision, refining the product strategy, developing a roadmap, and leading execution.
In this role, you will work closely with a broad set of cross functional teams across the entire business, as well as a number of engineering teams. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be commercially minded, be high agency with a bias towards action, and comfortable having technical conversations (and opinions).

What You'll Do

  • Drive the execution, growth, and scale of Affirm’s consumer products and experiences across international markets

  • Take Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and adapt them for international markets by understanding consumer needs, analyzing performance data, and iterating on the product’s features and capabilities

  • Drive success metrics by shipping high impact work that meaningfully moves the needle for Affirm’s business and customers

  • Partner effectively with engineering teams across the organization to drive product development and prioritization

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (such as Design, Research, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Fraud, etc.) to shape your product roadmap and incorporate legal, governance, and regulatory oversight into your products

  • Understand Affirm’s international consumers at a deep level: what’s important to them, what drives their decision making, why they love Affirm, and what they wish we could do better

  • Identify and create the experiences that make it seamless for consumers to discover, use, and manage Affirm across our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related direct-to-consumer offerings

What We Look For

  • This isn’t your first rodeo. You’ve directly managed technical software products from kick-off to post-launch – driving meaningful business impact that you can speak to

  • You have experience working on consumer technology products in Canada, UK, EU, or Australia (bonus points if that experience is in fintech, commerce, marketplaces, or payments)

  • You’re equally comfortable diving into technical details with an engineer, iterating on a Figma with a designer, and breaking down a funnel with a data analyst

  • You have the discipline, organizational skills, and interpersonal communication skills necessary to navigate complex organizational dynamics – you have specific examples of times when you’ve secured a decision from a broad group of senior stakeholders

  • You’ve worked in an environment where you were reliant on engineering teams outside of your direct purview and were able to effectively influence them to prioritize and build what you needed for your product

  • You’re the kind of person who cares about getting things done. You have a bias towards action and can effectively navigate obstacles and blockers

  • You can turn incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs into a solid action plan

  • You have direct experience shipping high-quality products on time

  • You feel comfortable jumping into the commercial aspects of product development – you’re able to connect customer needs, product decisions, and business outcomes, and make clear tradeoffs across them

Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

GBR base pay range per year: £120,000–£168,000 GBP

Location - Remote UK

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

Location:REMOTE (Eastern United States)

Position:Senior Program Management Analyst

Overview
ITC Defense is seeking a Senior Program Management Analyst to support strategic initiatives focused on the Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) and AUKUS programs. This position provides programmatic support to high-visibility defense initiatives that strengthen international partnerships and advance critical submarine industrial capabilities. Working in a dynamic, collaborative environment, the Senior Program Analyst will help ensure effective program execution, cross-functional coordination, and alignment with customer objectives while supporting the continued growth and success of complex defense programs.

What You'll Do

  • Support end-to-end execution of international defense programs while ensuring compliance with applicable contract requirements, ITAR, EAR, Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and other U.S. export control regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison among U.S. Government customers, foreign military partners, commercial suppliers, and cross-functional internal teams to support successful program execution.
  • Develop and manage integrated master schedules, budgets, risk mitigation plans, and contract deliverables to ensure program objectives are achieved within cost, schedule, and quality requirements.
  • Support Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) and AUKUS initiatives by collaborating with industry partners, suppliers, and stakeholders to enhance industrial capacity, workforce capability, and mission readiness.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, program status reports, and other customer-facing deliverables.
  • Support workforce planning and staffing activities necessary to meet program requirements.
  • Monitor program performance, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions to ensure successful execution.
  • Maintain effective coordination with engineering, legal, compliance, supply chain, and other internal stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Travel periodically to Washington, D.C., and other customer or partner locations as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Program Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience supporting defense acquisition, program management, submarine, shipbuilding, manufacturing, or related industries.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience supporting Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), AUKUS-related defense initiatives, and other applicable export control regulations.
  • Experience supporting the execution of complex international defense programs, including schedules, budgets, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and program reporting.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with U.S. Government customers, international partners, suppliers, and cross-functional teams.
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to government contract requirements.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), or other U.S. Government defense organizations.
  • Experience supporting international defense programs involving allied governments or foreign military organizations.
  • Experience supporting U.S. prime shipbuilders, defense suppliers, and industrial base or manufacturing initiatives related to submarine or naval programs.
  • Familiarity with the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), and additional U.S. Government acquisition and export control frameworks.
  • Prior military service or experience with a defense contractor.
  • Master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Program Management, or a related discipline.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of an Associate Security Engineer at Coupa:

Coupa's Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As an Associate Security Engineer, you'll build your foundation in cloud, application, and infrastructure security by contributing to real, well-scoped engineering work alongside experienced teammates. You'll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback.
This is a role for someone early in their security career who wants hands-on ownership of growing scope — with the support to get there.

What You'll Do:

  • Support the design and implementation of multi-cloud security controls — VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, and least-privilege IAM policies — on well-scoped tasks, with guidance from senior engineers. Build familiarity with permission boundaries and Organizations/SCPs along the way.
  • Contribute to policy as code and IaC security guardrails in CI/CD pipelines: write and tune rules, reduce false positives, and help keep pre-merge and pre-deploy checks reliable.
  • Assist in hardening containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters, including image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and network policies.
  • Triage vulnerability findings from application packages, container images, and third-party dependencies. Gather context on exploitability and business impact, and escalate complex or ambiguous findings to senior teammates.
  • Help the Risk & Compliance team gather technical evidence for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP), and learn what auditable evidence looks like.
  • Write and maintain scripts and small automations that make security work faster and more repeatable.
  • Learn from mentors through pairing, design reviews, and feedback on your remediation plans. Document what you learn and help improve runbooks.
  • Support the secure design, deployment, and operational monitoring of enterprise AI systems, models, and agentic workflows.
  • Help design and develop internal AI-driven security tools, automation scripts, and guardrails to improve threat detection and vulnerability remediation.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • 0–2 years of experience in security, cloud, DevOps, IT, or software engineering. Internships, co-ops, research, and hands-on personal or lab projects count.
  • Foundational knowledge of cloud security concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — IAM, networking, and common misconfigurations — gained through work, coursework, labs, or certifications.
  • Working scripting skills in Python, Bash, or JavaScript, and interest in building or extending internal security tooling.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanning concepts (dependency and container scanning). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines is a plus.
  • Basic awareness of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) and a willingness to learn how they translate into technical controls.
  • Curiosity and a habit of asking why — you want to understand the cause of a vulnerability, not just what the scanner reported.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions, asking for help, and escalating early.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, military, self-directed learning, or similar).
  • Entry-level certifications are a plus: Security+, ISC2 CC, AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS/GCP/Azure security certifications.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

Location Details: Remote, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

Join our team...
The Securities Analytics and Products Group is responsible for developing and maintaining sophisticated software solutions to safeguard GoDaddy's ecosystem. We are seeking a dedicated Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in software development and a keen focus on security. The ideal candidate will have proven hands-on experience in software development, with a consistent track record of working with the latest software technologies while prioritising security best practices.
As a key member of our engineering team, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing secure software solutions to protect our organisation from cyber threats. You will get to work with some of the brightest minds to build secure, highly available, fault-tolerant, and globally performant microservices-based platform deployed on the AWS cloud, using the newest technology stack. While the role is primarily backend-focused, you'll also get opportunities to contribute to frontend features as needed, giving you exposure across the full stack.

What you'll get to do...
  • Design, develop, and maintain secure, highly available, fault-tolerant, and globally performant code deployed on AWS cloud. Ensure code quality through extensive unit and integration testing
  • Own frontend features and UI components across projects on an as-required cadence, from design through delivery
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, ensuring your team's DevOps on-call responsibilities
  • Contribute to the technical documentation, code reviews, and mentoring fellow engineers
  • Work with both relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring scalable, efficient, and consistent data models
  • Build with observability in mind—instrument services with logs, metrics, and traces to ensure performance and uptime
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams

Your experience should include...

  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role. Demonstrated proficiency in Go, Python and Typescript.
  • Familiarity with AWS technologies such as EC2, Fargate, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch etc
  • Hands-on experience with databases—both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB)
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and other DevOps tools. Experience working in agile teams and deploying code using Git-based workflows and CI/CD technologies
  • Strong experience with version control software (Git preferred)
  • Proficiency in UI frameworks such as React (preferred) or Angular — frontend work arises intermittently across projects, so hands-on capability (not just familiarity) is expected when needed

You might also have...

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

  • Desenvolver capas, páginas internas, materiais promocionais, embalagens, apresentações e demais peças gráficas;
  • Realizar diagramação de materiais editoriais, garantindo organização visual, legibilidade e qualidade estética;
  • Adaptar artes e materiais conforme padrões visuais definidos pela marca e pelos licenciadores;
  • Criar desdobramentos de peças para diferentes formatos e canais de comunicação;
  • Realizar tratamento e edição de imagens, ajustes de arquivos e preparação de materiais para produção gráfica;
  • Trabalhar a partir de briefings, referências visuais e direcionamentos criativos, transformando conceitos em soluções visuais;

  • Experiência comprovada em design gráfico e desenvolvimento de materiais visuais;
  • Portfólio atualizado com projetos criativos e profissionais;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de criação e edição gráfica, como Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign;
  • Conhecimento em composição visual, tipografia, hierarquia de informação e identidade visual;
  • Capacidade de interpretar briefings e desenvolver soluções alinhadas ao objetivo do projeto;
  • Criatividade, senso estético, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes estilos visuais e públicos.

Informações adicionais

Who We Are

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best-in-class services team is key to our clients’ success. It can adapt quickly to regional or industry economic shifts, and provides the speed, scale, flexibility, transparency, and expertise required to meet an organization’s contingent workforce management, talent strategy and broader organization goals. At Magnit, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver meaningful results that positively transform the largest companies around the globe.

About The Role We’re looking for a pragmatic, solution-oriented employment and litigation lawyer to serve as Associate General Counsel, Americas. In this role, you’ll be responsible for overseeing employment and general litigation matters across the Americas, primarily the U.S. and Canada, providing legal guidance across a broad range of employment-related issues, and providing oversight of the legal operations and corporate governance functions supporting the region. This position reports directly to the General Counsel and will directly oversee and manage a small, but mighty team of in-house counsel and legal operations support professionals.

The role includes identifying and mitigating compliance risks and potential and actual claims against the Company and its’ affiliates, overseeing external counsel, and helping ensure the Legal department’s processes, systems, budgets, policies, and corporate governance practices operate effectively and at scale. This role is for you if you have a passion for providing creative, proactive, and pragmatic legal guidance. A successful candidate will be both a strategic advisor and hands-on problem solver.

What You Will Do

  • Provide advice and counseling on a broad spectrum of employment law issues primarily in the U.S. and Canada with a focus on California laws, including background checks, AI, recruiting, DEI, internal investigations, performance management, executive agreements, leaves of absence, accommodations, wage and hour, pay equity, terminations, and reorganizations/role eliminations, etc.
  • Work with other department members to identify, mitigate, and manage compliance and legal risk for the Company, including developing, reviewing, and revising internal policies, procedures, and governance frameworks, and supporting related training and awareness efforts
  • Provide legal representation and/or supervise outside counsel regarding employment litigation, general litigation, government administrative agency charges, audits, and investigations (e.g., EEOC, DOL, OSHA, and state/local agencies l), as well as pre-litigation demand letters and claims
  • Enforcement of contracts with temporary staffing agencies and other contingent labor providers.
  • Oversee a small team of corporate counsel and legal operations professionals in the U.S., setting priorities, developing talent, and ensuring consistent service delivery across the Americas
  • Provide oversight of the legal operations function, including matter and knowledge management, legal technology and systems, outside counsel engagement and panel management, legal spend and budget management, reporting and metrics, and continuous improvement of department workflows
  • Provide oversight of corporate governance matters for the Americas, including entity maintenance and corporate records, board and committee support, delegation of authority and signature policies, and related regulatory filings, partnering with internal stakeholders and outside counsel who handle day-to-day execution
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., People/HR, Product, Contracts, Finance, Operational Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, and business leadership) on enterprise initiatives, escalations, and risk governance
  • Advise and assist with other general legal needs as they arise
  • Serve as a senior member of the global Legal leadership team and taking on other responsibilities as assigned by the General Counsel

Required Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor degree
  • Member in good standing of a State Bar or the District of Columbia
  • 10-15+ years of employment and litigation experience; preferably a combination of in-house and law firm experience. Exposure to legal operations, corporate governance, or broader commercial/corporate matters is a plus
  • California wage and hour / PAGA experience required
  • Strong knowledge of labor and employment laws and regulations in various geographies
  • Self-motivated, able to work with minimal supervision, and assume significant responsibility
  • Prior experience managing and developing a team of attorneys and/or legal professionals
  • Experience overseeing or building legal operations capabilities (e.g., matter management, legal technology, outside counsel and spend management, process improvement, and department reporting)
  • Working knowledge of corporate governance and entity management practices, including board and committee support, corporate records, and delegation of authority a plus
  • Track record managing outside counsel and litigation budgets across a distributed, multi-state/country workforce
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment to prioritize and meet required deadlines

Compensation Salary range is $200,000-$225,000 USD annually. Salary rates are based on experience, skills, and geographical location.

What Magnit will Offer You

At Magnit,you’ll be joining an innovative, high-growth environment and can quickly make an impact to help transform the largest companies in the world. You will work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver. Magnit offers all employees the opportunity for growth and development, and we want individuals to fulfill their potential and blaze their own trails!

Magnit will offer you a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement planning, as well as discounts and perks for tickets, travel, merchandise and more! Magnit encourages employees to participate in giving back, and we will match employee contributions to favorite charities and support corporate volunteering hours to make a difference in your community!

If this role isn’t for you

Stay in touch, we will let you know when we have new positions on the team. To see a complete list of our open career opportunities please visit

To do our best work we need different viewpoints. Therefore, we celebrate diversity and embrace inclusion.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strive to ensure that we maintain a positive and enriching work environment for all.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities across external networks, web applications, and APIs. In this role, you will be responsible for the execution of penetration testing engagements, including identifying, validating, and manually exploiting vulnerabilities, evaluating potential attack paths, and documenting findings and remediation guidance. As the Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and creative strategies to support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Penetration Tester to support management, independently execute assigned projects, communicate technical findings to clients, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our offensive security tools, methodologies, and delivery processes.

Reports to

Director, Web Application & External Offensive Operations

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

  • Execute external network, web application, and API penetration testing engagements in accordance with defined scopes, methodologies, and rules of engagement
  • Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, internally developed techniques, or a combination of approaches
  • Evaluate attack paths and determine the potential business and technical impact of identified vulnerabilities
  • Compile and write clear, accurate, and defensible client reports that explain findings, risk, evidence, and remediation guidance
  • Communicate with clients throughout engagements, including technical discussions, findings walkthroughs, and responses to questions or challenges
  • Execute assigned projects with minimal oversight while maintaining quality, professionalism, and attention to detail
  • Collaborate with team members to evaluate offensive security tools and improve testing methodologies, delivery processes, and reporting standards
  • Share technical knowledge and practical guidance with less-experienced team members and clients when appropriate
  • Maintain current knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security research, and industry trends

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, management information systems, computer science, or relevant discipline

EXPERIENCE

  • 2-5 years of hands-on penetration testing experience in at least one of the following areas:
    • External Penetration Tests
    • Web Application Penetration Tests
    • API Penetration Tests
    • Mobile Application Penetration Tests
  • Experience independently executing penetration testing engagements and producing high-quality client deliverables
  • Knowledge of established penetration testing methodologies and disciplined evidence collection practices
  • Experience identifying and manually validating exploitable vulnerabilities rather than relying solely on automated scanning
  • Experience communicating technical findings, risk, and remediation guidance clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

CERTIFICATIONS

  • Preferred OSCP, eWPT, eWPTX, OSWA, or OSWE certification

SKILLS

  • Proficiency with commonly used offensive security tools such as Nmap, SQLmap, Burp Suite, Postman, Nuclei, Wireshark, Nessus, and Caido
  • Proficiency with one or more scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or SQL
  • Solid understanding of web technologies, networking concepts, authentication, access control, and common application security weaknesses
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a remote, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to different audiences
  • Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a high degree of motivation, self-discipline, and quality

  • Personalized Career Coaching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Summer Hours

Pathfynder by A-LIGN is a leading technology-enabled cybersecurity company providing premium offensive and defensive cybersecurity services operating under A-LIGN, a security and compliance partner trusted by more than 2,400 global organizations to confidently mitigate cybersecurity risks. We work with small businesses to global enterprises with services spanning across SOC, Penetration Testing, PCI DSS, HITRUST, ISO and privacy compliance. Our proprietary compliance management platform is transforming the compliance experience by enabling an anytime, anywhere approach to audits. For more information, visit www.A-LIGN.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

Shape the architecture behind an international B2B marketplace

Location: Remote, UK-based, with occasional travel to meet the senior team in the UK or Germany
Working hours: UK working hours, with reasonable flexibility for planned international meetings
Reports to: Chief Product Officer
We’re looking for an experienced Lead Software Architect to take technical ownership of the architecture and continued productisation of SteelBuy, our secure B2B marketplace connecting buyers and sellers of metal.
SteelBuy is part of tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, combining the agility of a developing digital platform with the industry expertise and international reach of an established global materials trading organisation.
Our immediate commercial and operational focus is the US market, but our ambitions go further. We want to develop SteelBuy into a scalable and adaptable technical product that can support different markets, business models and integrations in the future, potentially including Europe.

This is an opportunity to have a significant influence on that journey.

Key Responsibilities


As Lead Software Architect, you’ll provide the technical vision and architectural direction for the platform while remaining close enough to the technology to make pragmatic, informed decisions.
You’ll lead and mentor our back-end engineering team based in India, collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across the UK, Europe and US, and help establish the technical standards and ways of working that enable us to build a secure, scalable and high-quality product.
The role will cover back-end architecture, microservices, DevOps, enterprise integrations, APIs and distributed systems, alongside providing technical leadership to our internal development teams and external partners.

Although you'll occasionally work across international time zones, the role operates primarily around UK working hours. Routine alignment to US hours isn't expected.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own and evolve the overall software and systems architecture for SteelBuy, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, maintainable and adaptable.
  • Help transform the platform from a primarily US-focused implementation into a reusable technical product capable of supporting future markets and business models.
  • Translate business and system requirements into clear high-level technical designs, architecture and documentation.
  • Define functional and non-functional technical requirements and help shape the engineering backlog.
  • Lead architectural decisions covering technology, development approaches, workflows, integration patterns and coding standards.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to developers and engineers.
  • Oversee development to ensure solutions remain aligned with agreed architecture and design principles.
  • Establish and promote engineering best practice across areas including Agile delivery, test-driven development, automated testing and continuous integration.
  • Design effective REST APIs and microservices-based solutions.
  • Support the architecture of enterprise and ERP integrations.
  • Evaluate existing tools, frameworks and development approaches, identifying opportunities to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Remain technically engaged, contributing to solutions and code where your expertise can add value.
  • Support effective CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering and business stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Clearly communicate technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Help create a culture focused on technical excellence, continuous improvement and learning.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


We’re interested in people who combine strong architectural expertise with a practical, product-focused approach.
You’ll ideally bring:
  • Significant experience within software engineering, including experience designing software or systems architecture.
  • Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot andKotlin.
  • Experience designing microservices and distributed architectures.
  • Good knowledge of REST API design and system integration.
  • Experience working with eCommerce, marketplace or comparable digital platform architectures.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented analysis, design principles and common design patterns.
  • Good knowledge of relational databases, SQL and database schema design.
  • Experience with ORM technologies such as JPA/Hibernate or equivalent.
  • A strong understanding of automated testing, unit testing and test-driven development.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • The ability to turn complex business and technical requirements into clear architecture and technical direction.
  • Experience providing technical leadership, coaching or mentoring to engineering teams.
  • Experience working successfully with internationally distributed teams.
Experience in some of the following would be beneficial, but you don’t need to tick every box:
  • Terraform or Infrastructure as Code
  • GitHub Actions
  • JOOQ
  • Functional programming
  • Programming languages or technology stacks outside Java
  • Broader cloud and DevOps technologies
  • Enterprise or ERP integrations
  • Experience developing platforms for multiple countries, markets or business models

What will help you succeed


Technical expertise is important, but so is how you work. We’re looking for someone who can:
  • See the bigger picture while still being comfortable getting into technical detail.
  • Make considered architectural decisions and explain the reasoning behind them.
  • Build strong relationships across different teams, cultures and geographies.
  • Challenge constructively and collaborate to find the right solution.
  • Work independently and take ownership, while remaining part of the wider team.
  • Adapt as product and business priorities evolve.
  • Communicate confidently with engineers, product managers, senior stakeholders and customers.
  • Bring an Agile, curious and continuous-improvement mindset.

Qualifications


A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline would be beneficial. We also welcome candidates who can demonstrate equivalent professional experience and technical expertise through a different career or educational route.

  • Annual Leave: 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays

raw.description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.

We are looking for a Financial Analyst or Senior Financial Analyst to join Veeam’s Finance team in Costa Rica. This role will serve as a finance business partner to several General and Administrative functions, primarily supporting Operations, People & Culture, and Legal.

The Operations organization includes Corporate Technology (IT), Sales and Marketing Operations, Facilities, and Procurement.

  • Experience supporting G&A functions such as Corporate Technology (IT), People & Culture, Legal, Facilities, Procurement, or Operations.

raw.title: Senior Manager Impact and Intelligence
raw.excerpt: Position overview SNV is building a catalytic commercial accelerator, built to close the gap between capital and impact in markets where both are urgently needed.
raw.description:
Position overview
SNV is building a catalytic commercial accelerator, built to close the gap between capital and impact in markets where both are urgently needed. The Senior Manager for Impact and Intelligence is the intellectual engine within the unit. This role has two distinct but connected responsibilities: delivering client-facing impact measurement as a billable service, and synthesising knowledge across the portfolio to build a body of evidence that sharpens our offer and strengthens our market position.

This is not a back-office role. Impact measurement is a revenue line in its own right — impact investors, DFIs, and corporations with sustainability commitments are increasingly willing to pay for rigorous, credible measurement of their programmes. The right person combines analytical rigour with commercial awareness, and understands that evidence is only valuable if it changes decisions.

SNV holds a significant body of institutional knowledge — proposals, evaluations, programme data, sector evidence — accumulated across 50+ years and 25+ countries. Most of it is inaccessible or underused. This role is responsible for changing that: activating SNV’s knowledge base as a commercial asset, not just an archive.

Who you are
You are a curious and analytical professional who enjoys uncovering insights that help organisations make better decisions. You look beyond the data to understand what is happening, why it matters, and how evidence can be translated into practical action and measurable results.

You combine analytical rigour with commercial awareness. You understand that research, impact measurement, and intelligence create value when they influence strategy, strengthen client relationships, support business growth, or improve development outcomes. You are comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative data and know when deep analysis is required and when a pragmatic, timely recommendation is the better solution.

You are collaborative, proactive, and enjoy working across disciplines, bringing together perspectives from colleagues, clients, and partners. When you identify important trends, insights, or opportunities, you share them and help others act on them.

Most importantly, you are excited by the opportunity to turn evidence into impact. You identify insights that can be leveraged across the organisation, helping shape new approaches, strengthen market positioning, and inform business development decisions. You are equally motivated by building knowledge systems and intelligence mechanisms that support better future decision-making, reducing uncertainty through the effective use of data, intelligence, and learning.

Key Responsibilities

Client-facing impact measurement

  • Design and deliver impact measurement frameworks for clients — impact investors, blended finance facilities, agribusinesses, and government counterparts.
  • Develop results chains, theories of change, and indicator sets for IDF and ICVC engagements where measurement is part of the scope.
  • Conduct primary and secondary data collection, analysis, and reporting to investor-grade standards.
  • Package measurement outputs as standalone deliverables — not appendices to strategy documents.
  • Identify and convert standalone measurement mandates: fund impact reporting, programme evaluations, baseline and endline studies.
  • Stay current with impact measurement standards — IRIS+, IMP, GIIRS, and equivalents — and advise clients on which frameworks fit their reporting requirements.

Cross-portfolio intelligence

  • Synthesise findings and evidence across all Accelerator engagements into consolidated intelligence: what is working, for whom, at what cost, and under what conditions.
  • Build and maintain a knowledge base that captures reusable assets — frameworks, datasets, case studies, and sector-specific evidence — from every completed engagement. Every engagement should produce a reusable asset. You own the system that makes that happen and the quality standard it is held to.
  • Identify patterns in the portfolio that strengthen the offer: which client types convert fastest, which interventions generate the strongest returns, which geographies show the most traction.
  • Produce quarterly intelligence briefs covering portfolio-level insights and implications for strategy.
  • Own the donor and tender intelligence function: maintain a systematic view of active and upcoming funding opportunities relevant to the Accelerator’s two streams. This is an early operational priority — a structured weekly digest feeding the pipeline, not an ad hoc scan.

Sales enablement and competitive intelligence

  • Build and maintain the Accelerator's sales collateral: sector evidence packs, impact data sheets, and proof-of-concept case studies for both IDF and ICVC streams.
  • Conduct competitive landscape analysis — who else operates in our space, how they position, what they charge, where we are differentiated.
  • Track market trends in impact finance and value chain development that are relevant to pipeline development. Feed findings to the team.
  • Support proposal development with data, evidence, and impact methodology sections where required.

What you bring

To be considered for this role, you bring:

  • At least 8 years of experience in impact measurement, monitoring and evaluation, or related analytical roles — with a significant portion in a commercial or advisory context.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering impact measurement as a client-facing service, not just as internal reporting.
  • Familiarity with the impact investing and development finance landscape — understanding what DFIs and impact funds require from their portfolio companies and TA providers.
  • Experience synthesising evidence across multiple programmes or geographies into actionable insights.
  • Track record of producing high-quality analytical outputs under time pressure — reports, evidence reviews, data packs — to external standards.
  • Experience building or managing knowledge systems in a professional services or advisory context. A list of documents is not a knowledge base. You know the difference.

Additionally, we value:

  • Fluency in impact measurement frameworks: IRIS+, IMP, DCED, GIIRS, and at least one results-chain methodology.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills. Comfortable with both survey data and financial models.
  • Ability to translate complex evidence into clear, commercial-facing narratives.
  • Experience with knowledge management — building systems that people actually use, not just filing evidence.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted knowledge tools — document analysis, synthesis, search across large bodies of material. We are building AI-powered knowledge infrastructure and this role is its primary user.
  • English required. French or Portuguese an advantage.
  • Reporting line: Director
  • Location: Flexible.We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere within the time zones spanning Ghana to Singapore. As this role involves international collaboration and travel, candidates should be located within reasonable reach of a well-connected international airport.
  • Travel requirements: International travel will be required.
  • Expected start date: November/December 2026

What we offer
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package. Compensation is determined based on relevant experience, skills, and internal equity, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across the organisation.

Location & Travel
Flexible location. We are particularly interested in candidates based within the time zones between Singapore and Ghana, where most of our work is concentrated. International travel will be required, so candidates should have access to a major international airport.

Contract duration: We are looking for someone to play a long-term role in building and growing the Accelerator. Contract arrangements will vary by location and local employment requirements, and details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Working at SNV

The Senior Technical Advisor (STA), Development Bank Partnerships serves as technical leader on Multilateral Development Banks (MDB) engagement and development-finance partnerships including but not limited to CAF, the World Bank, GEF, BCIE, and Inter-American Development Bank. The STA leads the identification, design, and advancement of financing opportunities with MDBs and other development-finance partners to support CRS programming, while prioritizing implementation across Central America particularly in El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua. Working closely with regional and country program teams, CRS's global innovative finance team, and external financing institutions, the STA strengthens organizational capacity to access and leverage development-finance resources, develops and shares partnership approaches and technical guidance, and contributes to CRS's broader innovative finance agenda.

  • Lead CRS’s strategy, engagement, relationship management, and resource mobilization efforts with MDBs and other development-finance institutions, prioritizing opportunities that support programming in Central America while contributing knowledge and partnership approaches that can inform CRS programming more broadly.

Develop and share guidance, tools, and lessons learned to strengthen organizational capacity in these areas

  • Extensive knowledge of finance structures and mechanisms used in development programming particularly in climate finance
