Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

raw.description:
Grasshopper Bank is a client-first, digital bank built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.
We are a highly experienced team who pride ourselves on diversity of thought and perspective. Nationally chartered, our portfolio of products and services range from VC, PE & Portfolio Companies to SBA Lending, as well as direct SMB and Embedded Banking.
Our entrepreneurial drive allows us to support the growth and success of a wide range of clients at every stage of their business through inclusive partnership. We seek out team members who will enable both our organization and our people to grow and thrive through collaboration and acting with integrity and respect.
Our focus on cross-functional teamwork provides a culture where ideas are valued, accountability is encouraged, and successes are celebrated. We welcome all those searching for the opportunity to contribute to banking innovation that influences and supports the emerging digital world of Financial Services.
Our digital first approach enables our teams the flexibility to work remotely. We have offices in NYC and Boston.

What you'll do:

Grasshopper Bank is seeking a highly motivated Senior CRA Analyst to take ownership of the day-to-day execution and administration of the Bank’s Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) Program. In this role, you will apply your strong technical knowledge of CRA regulations to lead performance monitoring, manage data integrity, and coordinate regulatory reporting to ensure our digital commercial banking platform remains examination-ready.

As Grasshopper Bank actively prepares for and pursues a formal CRA Strategic Plan, this position will play a key role in preparing data baselines and establishing the tracking dashboards to monitor our progress against strategic goals.

In a shifting regulatory landscape, you will be expected to maintain up-to-date, forward-looking knowledge of the CRA environment, interagency regulatory updates, and modernizing rule changes.

Operating as a digital-first commercial bank, Grasshopper’s community development and lending initiatives focus strictly on the business and innovation economies. You will work cross-functionally with commercial underwriting, SBA lending, and treasury teams to ensure our commercial loans, SBA 7(a) and 504 originations, and qualified investments are accurately tracked, validated, and documented.

What You’ll Do
  • Own the end-to-end data collection, geocoding, and validation processes for commercial and Community Development (CD) loans, ensuring high-quality, audit-ready data.
  • Independently review, evaluate, and document qualified Community Development (CD) loans, investments, and service activities submitted by various business lines
  • Maintain the Bank’s CRA Public File and coordinate the compilation, scrubbing, and timely submission of annual small business loan registers under regulatory standards
  • Maintain records of the Bank’s qualified donations, sponsorships, and volunteer service hours targeting small business technical assistance and economic development
  • Lead the compilation of historical performance data, peer analyses, and baseline metrics to support the drafting, regulatory submission, and ongoing tracking of the Bank’s CRA Strategic Plan
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards to monitor Grasshopper’s progress against designated CRA Strategic Plan targets, proactively flagging areas of opportunity or risk
  • Actively track, analyze, and interpret the evolving CRA regulatory landscape, assessing the impact of new interagency modernization rules and advising on necessary adjustments to bank processes
  • Gather documentation, organizing technical request lists, and preparing data files for internal audits and OCC regulatory examinations

What you need:

  • 3–5 years of direct experience in CRA compliance, data analysis, or commercial loan compliance within a regulated financial institution
  • Advanced skills working with large datasets, geocoding tools, and reporting software to synthesize complex information into actionable compliance insights
  • Strong, up-to-date understanding of the Community Reinvestment Act, technical reporting requirements for small business loans, and upcoming regulatory modernization changes
  • Experience leveraging AI to document and package community development activities
  • Solid understanding of commercial loan files, SBA loan structures (7(a) and 504), and experience utilizing commercial loan systems (such as nCino)
  • Proven ability to manage data compliance projects independently, coordinate multi-departmental requests, and drive initiatives with minimal supervision
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, public policy, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CRCM) are a plus

SAP BRIM & FI-CA Consultant

Job Type: Contract
Location: Remote – United States or Canada
Preferred Time Zone: Eastern Time
Contract Duration: 9 months
Anticipated Start Date: September 1, 2026
Experience Required: 5–10 years

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP BRIM & FI-CA Consultant to support the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of enterprise billing and revenue-management solutions.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, technical teams, and integration partners to deliver scalable solutions supporting complex billing, invoicing, payments, collections, and contract-accounting processes.

The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) and SAP Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA), along with a solid understanding of subscription-based and usage-based billing models.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, implement, and support SAP BRIM and FI-CA solutions.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs and SAP configurations.
  • Configure and support FI-CA processes, including:
    • Business partners and contract accounts
    • Billing and invoicing
    • Payment processing
    • Dunning and collections
    • Returns, refunds, and write-offs
    • Account determination
    • Reconciliation and financial postings
  • Support SAP BRIM capabilities such as Convergent Invoicing, Convergent Charging, and Subscription Order Management, as applicable.
  • Configure and manage billable-item processing and downstream financial postings.
  • Design and validate integrations between SAP BRIM/FI-CA and SAP S/4HANA Finance, CRM, payment platforms, charging systems, and other upstream or downstream applications.
  • Participate in requirements workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution-design sessions, and business-process documentation.
  • Prepare functional specifications for interfaces, reports, enhancements, conversions, and workflows.
  • Collaborate with developers, integration teams, and business users to resolve functional and technical issues.
  • Support data migration, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and production deployment.
  • Investigate and resolve billing, invoicing, payment, and contract-accounting defects.
  • Provide post-production support and recommend process and system improvements.
  • Create and maintain configuration documents, functional specifications, test scripts, and user guides.
  • Communicate effectively with distributed teams across the United States and Canada.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of SAP consulting, implementation, or support experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP BRIM.
  • Strong functional and configuration experience with SAP FI-CA.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP BRIM or FI-CA implementation.
  • Strong understanding of billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, payments, collections, dunning, and financial posting processes.
  • Experience gathering requirements, performing fit-gap analysis, and creating functional specifications.
  • Experience configuring SAP solutions and supporting testing, deployment, and post-production activities.
  • Understanding of integrations between SAP BRIM/FI-CA and SAP Finance or S/4HANA.
  • Experience with SAP Convergent Invoicing, Convergent Charging, or Subscription Order Management.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based, usage-based, or consumption-based billing models.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote and distributed project environment.
  • Ability to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
  • Relevant SAP certifications are a significant plus.

raw.description:
DISCOVER IES
Integrative Emergency Services (“IES”) LLC, is a physician founded, owned, and led company whose goal is to empower physician leaders to create the best places to give and receive care. We are a clinically integrated and outcomes-based organization with a commitment to doing the right thing for our clinicians, patients, and communities. Through our commitment to patient care and reinvestment in our physicians, IES has a proven track record of improving patient outcomes and producing results that uphold the hospitals' reputations in which we operate. We strive to create a culture of continuous improvement, community, and recognizing our Physician leaders. To learn more, visit our website IES.Healthcare and click to see a highlight of our 12th Annual Quality Summit.

POSITION SUMMARY
Integrative Emergency Services, LLC (“IES”) is looking for a Physician Recruiter who will identify, qualify, interview, and contract with physician and advance practice provider candidates for our partner hospitals & clients. This position is responsible for strategic recruiting including managing effective, results-driven sourcing that identifies passive candidates, builds talent pipelines, generates referrals, and uses other creative methods to fill open and future positions. Will have a recruiting emphasis on Emergency Medicine, Hospitalists, and/or Anesthesiologists & CRNAs. Majority of work can be done remotely. Travel includes occasional visits to our Corporate office in Dallas, TX, recruitment events or conferences, and client sites. Preference for those based in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Must reside in a state IES operates in. IES currently supports sites in TX, AZ, OK, CO, IN, MO, AL, FL, SC, and D.C.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Include the following. Others may be assigned.

  • Coordinate recruitment efforts for assigned hospital/client vacancies to attract a sufficient number of qualified candidates to fill openings within an appropriate timeframe.
  • Develop sourcing and recruitment plans specific to each position, facility and market.
  • Maintain Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – enter and update pertinent candidate information.
  • Identify prospective candidates through cold calling, social media, internet resources, job boards and referrals.
  • Work with fellow recruiters to match candidates to multiple positions within IES.
  • Screen candidates to ensure they meet qualifications established by IES and client facilities.
  • Conduct rate surveys to establish fair market value in IES client markets.
  • Compile and maintain compensation data and hospital demographics in Fair Market Value database.
  • Provide detailed information to providers regarding the hospital, compensation plans, malpractice insurance, community facts, and IES.
  • Obtain verbal or written references from previous medical directors, nurse managers or staff physicians. Follow-up on all questionable references.
  • Coordinate itinerary for hospital interview and real estate tour for candidates, including arrangements with hospital administration.
  • Work with credentialing team and Practice Administrators to ensure the credentialing process for providers is completed in a timely manner.
  • Follow up with candidates throughout recruiting process, including job offer, negotiations, relocation, contract signing, and the first month of work.
  • Represent IES at conferences and job fairs.
  • Arrange and coordinate dinners with residency programs.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with candidates, hospital administration and IES staff to include Practice Administrators and Medical Directors.
  • Interact with members of the leadership team, including the CEO, COO, VP of Operations, and Recruiting Manager to convey information in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and update provider & client information in ATS to ensure reports and dashboards are accurate.
  • Assist in the day-to-day operation of the department.
  • Maintain professional image and conduct at all times and when interfacing with individuals outside of IES and in the local community.

QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

  • Ability to work in rapidly changing, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and verbal/written communication skills
  • Solid networking, cold calling, and negotiation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks
  • Customer service orientation
  • Ability to use discretion appropriately and maintain confidentiality
  • Think strategically while focusing on tactical execution
  • Proficient with MS Office applications
  • Ability to read, write and speak English proficiently

Education / Experience: Include minimum education, technical training, and/or experience preferred to perform the job.

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum 2 years of Physician and APP recruiting experience

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Specific vision requirements include the ability to see at close range, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to feel, and reach with hands and arms
  • Possess the ability to fulfill any office activities normally expected in an office setting, to include, but not limited to: remaining seated for periods of time to perform computer based work, participating in filing activity, lifting and carrying office supplies (paper reams, mail, etc.)
  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20-25 pounds
  • Fine hand manipulation (keyboarding)

WORK ENVIRONMENT:The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • Primarily remote setting
  • Preference for DFW based candidates - must reside in a state IES operates in
    • TX, AZ, OK, CO, IN, MO, AL, FL, SC, and D.C.
  • Required 3-5 days training/orientation at Corporate office in Dallas - 4835 Lyndon B Johnson Fwy, Dallas, TX 75244
  • May visit client hospital locations
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually low

TRAVEL

  • Occasional local and out of state travel may be required

What You Will Do:

The Employee Relations Consultant Leader is responsible for leading a team of Employee Relations Consultants who provide strategic, risk-informed, and practical employee relations support to business leaders, managers, and Human Resources partners across the organization. In a centralized Employee Relations model, this role ensures the ER Consultant team delivers consistent, high-quality guidance on workplace matters, including performance concerns, misconduct response, policy interpretation, restructuring support, conflict management, workplace behavior concerns, and other sensitive employee issues.

Reporting to the Director, Employee Relations, a successful candidate will oversee the day-to-day management, development, and effectiveness of the ER Consultant team, ensuring consultants are aligned to the business, operate consistently, and provide timely, practical, and defensible guidance. This is a new position; one in which will operate in close partnership with HR Business Partners, Employment Counsel, Ethics & Compliance, HR Operations, and a separate centralized Investigations team, and is accountable for driving ER consulting standards, case quality, service delivery, stakeholder confidence, and risk mitigation across the function.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Employee Relations Consultants aligned to business segments, functions, or geographies. Foster a team culture grounded in sound judgment, fairness, responsiveness, discretion, and practical problem-solving. Drive calibration across consultants to reduce variability in recommendations and outcomes.

  • Establish clear expectations and standards for consultant performance, judgment, responsiveness, documentation quality, stakeholder partnership, and risk management. Create strong operating discipline across the team, including consistent intake, consultation practices, and case management standards to ensure similar employee relations matters are handled consistently across business units, leaders, and regions, while accounting for applicable legal, cultural, and policy differences.

  • Provide ongoing direction, case consultation, and escalation support on sensitive or high-risk employee relations matters. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex or sensitive leadership situations. Maintain strong judgment around when issues should remain within consulting support versus when they should be escalated to investigations, legal, ethics, security, or senior HR leadership.

  • Build team capability in employee relations consulting, manager coaching, issue assessment, policy application, documentation practices, and workplace risk identification, promoting an approach that balances employee experience, business practicality, and organizational risk.

  • Partner with Investigations on scope alignment, business context, interim actions, stakeholder coordination, and post-investigation implementation. Maintain clarity between investigative fact-finding responsibilities and ER consulting/advisory responsibilities. Define and reinforce clear handoffs between ER Consultants, Centralized Investigations team, and broader HR and Legal teams, as applicable.

  • Partner with ER Operations or broader HR Operations teams, as applicable, to improve tools, workflows, reporting, knowledge management, and case documentation practices.

  • Contribute to the broader employee relations strategy, operating model refinement, and organizational readiness. Ensure consultants are viewed as credible, business-relevant, and consistent partners rather than solely reactive issue managers.

  • Support organizational restructuring efforts. drive and execute large-scale and small-scale reductions.

  • Stay up to date on changes in employment laws and regulations and ensure company policies and procedures remain compliant.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 10 years of related HR experience.

  • Experience building, scaling, and leading teams in large, global, and highly matrixed organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience leading employee relations professionals in a complex, matrixed, or multi-business environment.

  • Strong experience advising performance issues, misconduct, workplace behavior concerns, policy application, corrective action, and terminations.

  • Experience working within a centralized Employee Relations model.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, high-risk, and high-visibility issues with sound judgment and discretion.

  • Strong understanding of case management, documentation standards, issue triage, and cross-functional partnership.

  • Experience partnering effectively with Legal, HRBPs, and/or centralized investigations functions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communications.

  • Excellent organizational skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge of HR technologies, including HRIS and/or Case Management Tool

  • Ability to gather, analyze, and synthesize information and data from multiple sources and summarize investigative findings clearly and concisely in writing

  • ·Ability to prioritize work in fast paced environment

What Would Be Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting professional services, consulting, technology, or other complex business environments.

  • Experience building or scaling employee relations operating models, consultant frameworks, or service delivery structures.

  • Strong familiarity with global employee relations considerations and region-specific employment practices.

  • Experience using case management systems, ER metrics, and trend reporting to inform decisions and improve service delivery.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)Remote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Systems Engineer, System Administrator, Desktop Support Engineer, Service Desk Analyst

Could you keep 425 people working from one Slack queue, and still say no to the wrong access request?

On a typical day you might get a new tutor's Google Workspace, Slack and MFA live before their first class in the morning, work through a campus access point that keeps dropping with the MSP after lunch, and finish by turning today's fix into a knowledge base article the next person can follow.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

Most people only notice IT when it stops working. This role is the reason they rarely do.

About This Role

You are the L1 and L2 support engineer for the whole company: the person staff message when something breaks, and the person who fixes most of it. You run the service desk, administer Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot and the approved AI platforms, look after a fleet of macOS and Windows devices, and support the UniFi network, CCTV and door access across the Melbourne campuses with the local MSP on the ground. You report to the Senior Systems Engineer, who owns architecture, security policy, vendor contracts and any change to how a system is built. Everything at L1 and L2 is yours.

The standard here is different in two specific ways. First, security. Contour holds staff and student data, and most of what goes wrong in IT security goes wrong through a helpful support person granting access nobody checked. When a rushed request for broad access lands, the right move is to slow down and ask what the person needs to do, and you have to be able to do that with a senior manager on the other end. Second, repeat work. The third time you would do a task by hand, you propose the automation instead, and every fix gets written down, because a fix nobody can find is a fix you will do again.

This is a hands-on seat. You take the ticket, fix what you can, and hand up only what needs a senior pair of hands. You are the first dedicated support hire on the offshore technology team, working with that engineer and the Melbourne team, and the team grows around this seat as the company does.

Contour has grown to this size with technology support handled alongside other jobs. This role makes it someone's whole job. By the end of month three you will be working the queue to its response and resolution targets without escalating anything you could have fixed yourself, and running joiner, mover and leaver changes end to end including offboarding. You will have the most common fixes written up in the knowledge base and your first automation proposed. The runbooks you write in those months are the ones the team will still be following in three years.

Where the work lives

  • Slack, where the service desk lives:every request goes through the queue. Acknowledge there rather than in a DM, because the queue is the record and the report.

  • Google Workspace and the identity platform:accounts, groups, licences and MFA are set to match the role, so a joiner is working on day one and a mover carries nothing across that they should not.

  • macOS and Windows devices:enrolment and configuration follow the standard build, so a device is done when it matches the build.

  • UniFi:the controller tells you what the network is doing. Read it before you or the MSP touch anything.

  • The knowledge base:a fix is finished when it is written up so the next person can follow it without you.

  • The password manager:credentials live here and nowhere else.

What You Will Do

  • Work the queue.Acknowledge, triage and resolve L1 and L2 requests in the Slack service desk, and close the loop with the person who raised each one. Escalate what sits above L2.

  • Administer the workplace platforms.Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot and the approved AI tools: accounts, groups, licences and permissions. Run joiner, mover and leaver access changes through the identity platform, including 2SV and MFA enrolment. Enrol, configure and fault-find macOS and Windows devices.

  • Keep the campuses connected.Support the UniFi stack across sites: access points, switches, guest and staff networks. Support CCTV and door access control, including adds, removes and fault escalation. Work campus network issues with the Melbourne MSP and hold them to what they committed to.

  • Support the systems other teams run on.Sales and go-to-market, finance, and the tools tutors use: access, configuration and first-line support.

  • Follow the process.Raise a change record before touching production, log incidents in full, and contribute to root cause analysis. Write and maintain knowledge base articles and how-to guides for the tech team and for end users, and keep system documentation current for what you touch.

  • Hold the line on access.Grant the least someone needs to do their job, and raise a request that looks broader than the role rather than granting it. Complete the offboarding checklist in order and in full. Report suspected phishing, unusual account activity and possible data exposure straight away: speed beats certainty here. Never share credentials outside the password manager, and pull people up when they ask you to.

  • Automate the repeat work.Propose the automation with the hours it saves and the tool you would use. Use the same AI tools in your own work and help staff use them well, including what must never be pasted into them.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 to 4 years in IT support, service desk or systems support, including L2 work where the fix was yours to own

  • Hands-on administration of Google Workspace or Microsoft 365: accounts, groups, licences and permissions, done by you. You support both macOS and Windows

  • Networking fundamentals in practice: IP addressing, VLANs and wireless, and the habit of reading a network issue rather than guessing at it

  • Identity and access basics: users, groups, roles, least privilege, MFA and 2SV

  • Time on a ticket queue measured on first response and time to fix

  • Clear written English. You explain fixes to non-technical people several times a day, and your write-up is what the next person follows, so clarity is part of the job

  • Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference. The people you support are in Melbourne

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on UniFi, CCTV or door access control work

  • HubSpot, Rippling, Aircall or Notion administration

  • Light scripting or automation: Google Apps Script, Zapier or Make.com scenarios, or basic Python

  • Time in education or another environment that handles student or minor data

  • A diploma, degree or certification in the field: CompTIA A+ or Network+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Google Workspace Administrator

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Fast first, then thorough:every ticket gets a quick first response and a fix that holds, in that order.

  • Closed means confirmed:a ticket closes when the person who raised it says it works.

  • Escalations carry evidence:what you tried, what you saw, what you ruled out, so the senior engineer starts where you stopped.

  • Offboarding leaves nothing behind:a leaver's access is gone on the day, with a name against every step.

  • Repeat work shrinks:the queue gets lighter over the year because recurring tickets get automated or documented out of it.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. No travel: the campus hardware is in Melbourne and you work it through the MSP and the onshore team. Compensation details shared early in the hiring process. You will hear from us within a week of applying, and the process is a written screen, a short video response, a practical task, and two conversations.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a request you slowed down, scoped down or refused because it was not safe, and what happened next.

About Bidaya

At Bidaya, we help architecture, engineering, and construction firms win more work with AI. We turn a firm's past proposals, documents, and expertise into a faster, smarter way to find the right opportunities and respond to them well.

Bidaya surfaces the opportunities that fit each firm's strengths, then helps teams draft strong, compliant proposals in a fraction of the usual time. We take on the research and the heavy lifting of writing, so their teams can focus on the work they do best.

We are a profitable, venture-backed team of four based in Calgary, with customers across Canada and internationally.

The Role

We are looking for our first dedicated customer success hire: someone who has lived the proposal grind inside an AEC firm and wants to help others win. You will own how new firms get started with Bidaya and how they keep getting value from it, and you will be the person our customers know by name.

Because you know this industry from the inside, your feedback on the product and on proposal quality will carry real weight with the founders.

What You'll Own

  • Onboarding and activation, from kickoff to a firm's first submitted proposal. You run the first call on a live RFP and stay with the team until they can do it without you.

  • Adoption across the base. Proposal teams build Bidaya into their daily workflow because you removed what was in the way, from messy templates to missing style guides.

  • Support and the voice of the customer. You are the person customers reach, and you turn what you hear into clear priorities for the founders.

Who We're Looking For

  • You have led marketing, business development, or proposals inside an AEC or professional services firm, and you have submitted more RFP responses than you can count.

  • You have used ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot in real proposal work and have opinions about what helps and what doesn't.

  • You write clearly and quickly, whether you are coaching a customer or documenting a process.

  • You enjoy building relationships with customers and are comfortable running a call with a firm's principal.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment with room to shape the role.

  • Bonus if you speak French (we have numerous clients in Quebec)

Why Join Us

This is a founding seat with real ownership. You will work directly with the founders, set the playbook for how Bidaya serves its customers, and have a direct hand in the product and the market. If you have sat on the firm side wishing this tool existed, this is your chance to build it from the inside.

raw.description:
For more than a century, Big Brothers Big Sisters has been helping change kids’ perspectives and giving them the opportunity to reach their potential.

Since 1904, Big Brothers Big Sisters has operated under the belief that inherent in every child is incredible potential. As the nation’s largest donor- and volunteer-supported mentoring network, Big Brothers Big Sisters makes meaningful, monitored matches between adult volunteers (“Bigs”) and children (“Littles”), ages 5 through young adulthood in communities across the country. We develop positive relationships that have a direct and lasting effect on the lives of young people.

Position Purpose

As a direct report of the Senior Director, Learning and Development (L&D), the Learning Experience Designer (LXD) supports the design, development, and delivery of engaging learning experiences that advance BBBSA’s strategic priorities and learner needs. The LXD combines instructional design, digital content development, learning management system (LMS) administration, and learner support to create effective, learner-centered solutions for BBBSA staff and agencies.

Location: Continental United States (100% Remote)
FSLA Status: Full time, Exempt
Travel: Approximately 10%

Remote Work Location Requirement: This position is approved for remote work within the Continental United States only. Any permanent change to the geographic location of an employee’s remote work arrangement from the region identified at the time of hire must be reviewed and approved in advance by both the employee’s direct manager and Human Resources.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conduct needs assessments and analyze requests from internal customers to identify learning and performance needs.
  • Design and develop engaging learning experiences using adult learning principles and instructional design best practices.
  • Create eLearning courses in Articulate Rise 360, instructional videos, job aids, performance support resources, and other digital learning assets.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs), colleagues, users, and leaders to develop learning solutions aligned with organizational goals.
  • Administer and maintain learning content within the LMS, including publishing, updating, testing, and troubleshooting content.
  • Monitor, investigate, resolve, and document LMS-related support requests and tickets, escalating issues as appropriate.
  • Conduct quality assurance testing of courses, learning plans, enrollments, completions, and learning technologies.
  • Generate and analyze LMS reports to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate learning sessions and forums, both in-person and virtual, as needed.
  • Develop and maintain learner guides, job aids, knowledge articles, and support documentation.
  • Stay current on learning technologies, instructional design trends, and best practices.
  • Solve problems creatively and align decisions with the organization’s values.

Culture

  • Demonstrates a commitment to BBBSA’s shared leadership competencies and organizational values.
  • Provides consistent follow-up regarding assigned projects and commitments.
  • Cultivates an environment where all team members feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their potential.
  • Manages related and other duties as assigned in support of department and business needs.

Education, Skills & Related Work Experience

Education: Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technologies, Educational Technology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field preferred. Master's degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technologies, Educational Technology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field is a plus. We also welcome candidates who have gained equivalent knowledge and expertise through a combination of relevant work experience, professional certifications, training, and other educational pathways in learning experience design, instructional design, adult learning, or related disciplines.

Years of Related Work Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in instructional design, digital learning development, LMS administration, learning technologies, or related fields. Experience supporting a national affiliate or distributed network is preferred.

Required

Our Commitment

At Big Brothers Big Sisters of America, we recognize, affirm, and celebrate the backgrounds, lives, and experiences of all of our stakeholders, including youth, families, donors, volunteers, and staff. We ensure the opportunity for all voices and perspectives to be heard and honored. In the workplace, we foster an environment where all people can be their best selves. We affirm that every person has the opportunity to reach their full potential. We strive to realize the full potential that is within all of us by ensuring that all voices and perspectives are heard and honored.

Equal Employment Opportunity

BBBSA provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, citizenship, religion, national origin, age, sex, familial or marital status, pregnancy, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Americans with Disabilities Act

Employee must be able to perform all essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Job Responsibilities

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. BBBSA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Big Brothers Big Sisters of America is directly recruiting and hiring for this position. We are not engaging any staffing/recruitment firms or agencies for this position. If any candidate profile/resume/identifying information is sent to Big Brothers Big Sisters of America and/or Big Brothers Big Sisters agencies, we will not pay any referral or firm fees in relation to this information.

raw.description:
Join ICF as a User Enablement Specialist supporting the ongoing operations and continuous improvement of GrantLens, a federal Salesforce grants management solution. You will provide dedicated solution-level user enablement support for GrantLens capabilities in production and help ensure users have the training, guidance, and support needed to effectively use the system.


As GrantLens evolves through new program onboarding, enhancements, and ongoing releases, you will translate product and process changes into practical user enablement. You will assess what changed, which personas and workflows are affected, what users need to understand or do differently, and what training, guidance, or support is required. The role provides continuity across onboarding, persona- and role-based training, release upskilling, self-service resources, instructional content, in-app guidance, and hypercare.


You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Quality Assurance testers, developers, process and support teams, and federal stakeholders to keep user-facing resources aligned with current production functionality. The ideal candidate is a technically fluent enterprise application enablement professional who can independently learn complex functionality, operate comfortably within an Agile software delivery lifecycle, and translate evolving system behavior into clear guidance for non-technical users.


Job Location:

This position is fully remote within the U.S., with occasional travel to the client's Washington, D.C. office. Must support U.S. Eastern time zone working hours.


What You Will Do:

  • Develop, maintain, and deliver foundational, persona-specific, role-based, and ongoing training for programs and users transitioning onto or operating within GrantLens.
  • Perform user-impact analysis for enhancements and releases by reviewing requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, demonstrations, testing outcomes, and other release artifacts to determine affected personas, workflows, knowledge needs, and required enablement actions.
  • Translate complex system functionality, permissions, personas, sub-roles, and end-to-end workflows into clear training and guidance tailored to distinct user responsibilities.
  • Develop and maintain job aids, quick-reference guides, help and knowledge content, system demonstrations, instructional videos, FAQs, presentations, and other user-facing resources as the production solution evolves.
  • Develop and maintain instructional content for approved in-app guidance and digital adoption capabilities in coordination with O&M technical resources.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release readiness, demonstrations, and related software delivery activities as needed to understand functionality, validate user-facing workflows, identify enablement impacts, and prepare accurate production-aligned resources.
  • Support users following onboarding and releases through hypercare and targeted enablement; use recurring questions, user feedback, testing findings, support trends, and available adoption or usage data to identify knowledge gaps and prioritize enablement improvements.
  • Maintain content governance, version control, naming conventions, and lifecycle management for user-facing training and knowledge resources so users have access to current, production-aligned guidance.
  • Partner with Product, Business Analysis, Quality Assurance, development, process, and support teams to proactively identify enablement needs and maintain alignment between product changes and the user experience.
  • Develop user-facing digital learning and documentation with accessibility and Section 508 considerations appropriate to a federal technology environment.

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience supporting user enablement, enterprise system training, digital learning, or enterprise technology implementations.
  • 3+ years of experience performing user-impact or training-needs analysis for software changes and translating requirements, release information, workflows, or system behavior into targeted enablement actions.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and delivering persona-, role-, or workflow-based training for enterprise applications with differentiated permissions and user responsibilities.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and delivering instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and release-based system training and upskilling.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing presentations, job aids, user guides, FAQs, knowledge articles, instructional videos, and system demonstrations.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence for requirements, release, issue, documentation, or knowledge-management workflows.
  • 2+ years of experience with screen capture, screen recording, video editing, PDF editing, and multimedia content-development tools used to create instructional resources.
  • Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.
  • Must be a United States (U.S.) Citizen or Green Card holder, and the work must be performed in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract.
  • Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three (3) full years out of the last five (5) years.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly Salesforce-based enterprise or grants management solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, cross-functional collaboration, systems thinking, creative problem-solving, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, maintain accurate content across concurrent releases, and proactively identify user enablement needs in a fast-moving product environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and productivity tools, including presentation, document, spreadsheet, file-sharing, and collaboration applications.
  • Working knowledge of Agile software delivery and testing concepts, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, defects, UAT, releases, deployments, and production versus non-production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex enterprise applications and independently develop the functional knowledge needed to train and support end users.
  • Experience with federal grants programs, grants management processes, and/or federal technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience creating instructional content with Google Vids, Adobe Acrobat, or comparable video, screen-capture, and document-authoring tools.
  • Experience with digital adoption platforms or in-app guidance technologies used to deliver contextual walkthroughs, tips, and embedded user support (e.g., Appinium, Articulate 360, Tango Ai, etc.)
  • Experience with knowledge-management platforms, help centers, Learning Management Systems (LMS), or service-management/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience coordinating or supporting UAT, release readiness, defect/retesting cycles, and post-release hypercare for enterprise applications.
  • Experience using testing findings, support data, user feedback, or adoption/usage information to identify knowledge gaps and improve training or self-service resources.
  • Experience developing accessible digital learning and documentation in accordance with Section 508 or comparable accessibility standards.
  • Relevant certifications or formal training in instructional design, adult learning, change management, Agile delivery, Salesforce, accessibility, or related disciplines.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer.Together, our employees are empowered to share theirexpertiseand collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEOpolicy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals withsincerely heldreligious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To requestan accommodation,please email  and we will be happy toassist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extentrequiredto provide needed reasonable accommodations. 

Read more about workplace discrimination rightsor our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) CoverageAct.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate orassistwith responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is notpermitted. This policy is in place tomaintainthe integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. Ifsuch anaccommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . Weare dedicated to providingthe necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

Role Title: Software Engineer (GitHub Contributor)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Anywhere in the world, remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $50–100/hour

Time per task: ~15 hours per run

Onboarding: As soon as you’re selected, Talent Ops will send you everything you need to get started

You’ll need: clear open source contributions and a profile to showcase them, such as GitHub (preferably with C++, Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, or Rust). If you don’t, you’ll be assessed through a HackerRank assessment instead.

Your tasks: Build reproducible Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to fix code, add features, refactor, and optimize performance - including a golden reference solution for each problem

Bonus: experts who complete the AI interview for this specific role move through the process significantly faster.

We care about your human judgment: our interview and assessment stages are designed to see how you think, so we ask that you complete them on your own, without AI assistants or help from others.

Job Description

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

You'll create realistic, interesting and challenging coding tasks for AI to solve involving feature implementation and bug fixes, and implement deterministic verifiers that accept reasonable valid solutions and reject everything else.

What we're looking for

  1. Strong backend experience in Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, Typescript, Python, C++ or similar
  2. A track record building scalable services and APIs
  3. Comfort with debugging, performance work and automated testing
  4. Solid code review instincts

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven experience in backend development, with a track record of delivering high-quality and performant projects.
  2. Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving software bugs and system bottlenecks.
  3. Experience with codebase refactoring and implementing complex features in large-scale applications.
  4. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and foundational computer science concepts.
  5. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Scope of Work

  1. Contribute expert-level code samples, debugging strategies, and development insights in Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks in diverse codebases.
  3. Implement robust new features, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to software best practices.
  4. Refactor and optimize legacy code to improve clarity, efficiency, and long-term reliability.
  5. Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality.
  6. Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  5. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects.
  6. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  7. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).

Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 20 minutes)
  3. Technical Assessment (if your GitHub profile doesn’t fully showcase the expertise required for this role)
  4. Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Integrations

About the job

HeroDevs is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Shared Services team. We're the shared services team behind HeroDevs, the company that keeps critical open-source software secure long after it reaches end of life. We build and run the platforms, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure the rest of the company depends on. That includes the systems that deliver data and secure package releases to our integration partners. We care about doing things carefully, automating what shouldn't be manual, treating infrastructure as code, and building systems other engineers can trust and extend.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep infrastructure experience who also enjoys building the integrations that run on it. You'll own the design, reliability, and security of the cloud platform behind our partner integrations, and you'll build and evolve the pipelines that move data and package releases between our internal systems, our APIs, and our partners.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll shape technical direction, set the patterns other engineers follow and propose architecture decisions with the team. We're looking for someone who's comfortable with ambiguity, and thinks about failure modes before they happen.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure that supports our integrations and shared platforms (compute, storage, networking, queues, scheduled workloads, and IAM)
  • Own infrastructure-as-code across environments
  • Architect and build reliable, secure data and package-delivery pipelines between internal systems, internal APIs, and integration partners
  • Lead technical design for new partner integrations, including data contracts, delivery mechanisms, validation, retries, and failure handling
  • Build and improve CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including build, test, release, and deployment automation for services and infrastructure
  • Establish observability practices (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and SLOs) so problems surface early and are easy to diagnose
  • Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for integration and infrastructure failures, and drive the follow-up work so they don't recur
  • Champion security across the platform, including use of secrets management, least-privilege access, supply chain integrity, and safe handling of partner data
  • Write services and tooling primarily using TypeScript/Node.js, packaged and deployed as containers
  • Review code and design documents
  • Write and maintain architecture docs, runbooks, and operational guides for the systems you own

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE work
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure considered)
  • Production experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
  • Demonstrable proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) or Python for building services, automation, and tooling
  • Experience designing and operating data pipelines, API integrations, or ETL systems in production
  • Deep familiarity with containers (Docker) and deploying containerized workloads, preferably on kubernetes
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions
  • Solid understanding of networking, IAM, and cloud security fundamentals
  • Experience with observability tooling and with participating in or leading on-call and incident response
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to drive technical decisions in a distributed team
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with git-based software development and GitOps practices (preferably on GitHub)

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills

  • Background in software supply chain security, package registries, or artifact signing and provenance (e.g., Sigstore, SLSA)
  • Experience working with external partners on data exchange, including SFTP, webhooks, or partner APIs
  • Familiarity with the npm ecosystem and package publishing workflows
  • Experience defining SLOs and improving reliability for systems with external consumers
  • Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead
  • Interest in open-source software and long-term maintenance of critical software

At HeroDevs, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion to drive innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to creating a workplace that embraces and celebrates individual differences. We encourage people of all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

raw.description:
The Sr. Sales Executive is the principal representative of RRD responsible for understanding and representing the products, services, and solutions it provides to clients. The role is to recognize revenue opportunities and turn leads into long-lasting partnerships. A Sr. Sales Executive is responsible for promoting sales in creative and effective ways through a sophisticated consultative process with clients. The position requires product knowledge, an understanding of industry trends, and ability to develop strategic plans with a high level of planning and foresight to maximize sales and revenue from existing clients as well as new clients and prospects. In the position you will act as a subject matter expert and mentor to less experienced sellers. Sr. Sales Executives working on the Brand Integration Team are responsible for selling to Franchises and Agencies.

  • New Business Development & Strategic Sales (60%)

    • Establish a strategic, consultative sales process to engage prospective and existing clients across company products, services, and solutions.
    • Build strong client partnerships and custom sales strategies by developing a deep understanding of customer business models and marketing/advertising initiatives.
    • Collaborate with internal RRD product sales experts to architect and propose optimized, end-to-end customer solutions.
    • For Brand Integration Team: Drive sales targeting Franchise and Agency client segments.
    • Travel as required to conduct client meetings and present tailored sales strategies.

  • Account Management & Client Retention (30%)

    • Maintain and expand existing customer accounts by delivering comprehensive strategic account management.
    • Research, leverage, and tailor market data and commercial insights to consult clients and execute solution selling.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact to ensure seamless implementation and prompt resolution of client concerns.
  • Reporting & Forecasting (10%)

    • Provide accurate, timely sales pipeline reports and revenue forecasting as required by leadership.

  • Education & Experience
    • Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
    • Experience: 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role with a demonstrated track record of quota attainment.
    • Domain Experience: Media sales experience required; experience selling directly to Agencies and Franchises preferred.
    • Preferred Industry Focus: Prior experience selling into Telecom, Financial Services, or Consumer Services verticals.

  • Job Knowledge & Required Skills

    • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of print products, media solutions, and relevant industry trends.
    • Preferred Experience: Directly with Telecom, Financial, and/or Consumer Services experience.
    • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in CRM software, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace applications.
    • Sales Competencies: Proven ability to consult, influence, and educate C-suite/key stakeholders to close business.
    • Problem Solving & Communication: Advanced written and verbal communication skills with strong independent problem-solving and critical thinking capabilities.

  • Grundverständnis von Design-Systemen und Storybook.
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Agile-Methoden (Scrum / Kanban).

Benefits

raw.title: AI-First Marketing Lead (m/w/d) - Remote
raw.excerpt: refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers.
raw.description:
refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. We work with retailers like Puma, EuroShop, and Orlen and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond. We are a close-knit team, distributed across three continents, with a base in Berlin. We're building an AI powered startup, flat heirarchy and a tight, efficient team.

This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.

The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.

Tasks

  • Content quality and brand voice: Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.
  • AI content engine: Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.
  • Account-based marketing support: Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.
  • SEO and inbound: Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.
  • Brand and thought leadership: Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.
  • Events and field: Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.
  • Partner co-marketing: Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.
  • Metrics and reporting: Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.

Requirements

  • 6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.
  • You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.
  • Fluent, flawless native spokend and written english
  • Agentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have it is how this role operates day to day.
  • Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.
  • Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.
  • Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.
  • HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.
  • Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.
  • One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.

Benefits

  • End-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth path
  • The chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problem
  • Attractive compensation package and options after year 1
  • Training budget and access to the latest AI tooling
  • Direct access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day one
  • Work from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connection

We use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.

To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.

  • Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.
  • Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think.

Note: The hourly pay range listed above represents a good-faith estimate of the minimum and maximum target for this position. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on the candidate's geographic location, job-related skills, experience, and education.

About the Role

At DirectMeds, our Logistics team plays an important role in keeping patient accounts moving efficiently through fulfillment and shipping workflows.

As a Logistics Agent, you'll monitor patient account activity, identify delays or stalled workflows, troubleshoot fulfillment concerns, and collaborate with internal teams to help ensure issues are resolved quickly and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, pays close attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where communication, accountability, and follow-through make a difference.

The Ideal Candidate

You're someone who:

  • Takes ownership of issues and follows through until they're resolved.
  • Enjoys identifying problems, investigating details, and finding solutions.
  • Notice small details that others may overlook.
  • Stays organized and focused while managing multiple priorities.
  • Communicates clearly, professionally, and with empathy.
  • Works independently while collaborating effectively with other departments.
  • Understands the importance of urgency, accuracy, and accountability.
  • Adapts quickly to changing priorities and operational needs.
  • Is proactive about identifying opportunities to improve workflows.

What You'll Do

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage and monitor patient account workflows to ensure timely processing and fulfillment.
  • Identify stalled accounts, processing delays, and workflow issues that may impact patient orders.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot logistics and fulfillment-related concerns.
  • Escalate unresolved or time-sensitive issues through appropriate internal channels.
  • Collaborate with customer service, pharmacy operations, fulfillment, and other internal teams to resolve account concerns.
  • Communicate directly with patients when additional information, clarification, or follow-up is needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of account updates, escalations, and resolutions.
  • Monitor outstanding issues and follow through to ensure appropriate resolution.
  • Follow established logistics workflows, internal procedures, and escalation protocols.
  • Identify recurring operational challenges and communicate trends or potential improvements to leadership.
  • Prioritize urgent patient account concerns while managing multiple tasks in a high-volume environment.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Strong investigative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence in handling patient-related concerns professionally and efficiently.
  • Comfort navigating internal systems, administrative tools, and operational workflows.
  • The ability to quickly learn and follow established processes.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Reliability, accountability, and the ability to work independently.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach to resolving operational challenges.

Preferred Qualifications (Strong Plus)

  • Previous experience in logistics, fulfillment, operations, or patient support.
  • Familiarity with internal systems, administrative tools, and account management workflows.
  • Experience handling escalated situations or complex patient account issues.
  • Experience working in a high-volume customer service or operational support environment.
  • Previous experience coordinating across multiple departments to resolve account concerns.
  • Cancel-save, customer retention, or account recovery experience.
  • Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, telehealth, or related operations.

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates must have the following available prior to their start date:

  • Reliable personal laptop or desktop computer (Chromebooks not accepted)
  • Quality headset suitable for patient and team communications
  • High-speed, reliable internet connection
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for confidential patient conversations

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits package (Health, Dental, and Vision).
  • Fully remote position.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for career growth within a rapidly scaling company.
  • Exposure to innovative therapies in wellness and longevity.

How to Apply

If you're interested in joining DirectMeds as a Logistics Agent, we'd love to hear from you!

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your relevant experience in logistics, fulfillment, customer service, patient support, or operational problem-solving and why you're interested in the role.

Direct Meds is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are TAG, a digital agency that helps top-tier brands create beautiful digital experiences that drive performance. You are curious, decisive, and data-driven. You define what clients should measure and why, diagnose implementation issues, and turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations. You keep up with where measurement is heading, from server-side tagging and attribution to privacy legislation and AI, and you want to help shape how our analytics offering grows.

What You’ll Do

About Third and Grove

Third and Grove is a fully remote full-service digital agency. Our vision is to use technology and design to make the web worth browsing. We want to leave the web better than we found it. TAG team members strive to embody our core values, leading with empathy and practicing accountability, excellence, integrity and curiosity -in everything we do.
