raw.description:
Product Development Owner

Buffalo Grove, IL

Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm

Remote

Do you want to build software that removes the manual work tax professionals dread every cycle?

CSC Corptax is looking for a Product Owner who pairs strong product fundamentals with a practical, hands-on approach to AI. You will own outcomes for a product area, work with your scrum team inside an agile delivery model, and find ways to eliminate the repetitive data preparation and validation work our clients do today. You will also use AI in your own daily work to move faster from client problem to shipped capability. Some of your work will extend an established product; some will mean shaping a new concept or rethinking an area from the ground up.

If you measure success by client outcomes, like taking apart a messy process to find what can be automated, and see AI as a tool to change how work gets done (not a buzzword), we want to talk with you.

Some of the things that you will be doing?

  • Own outcomes for your product area: Maintain a Now/Next/Later roadmap tied to system year and PI goals. Define success metrics before work starts, commit to “Now” scope you can deliver, and make clear trade-off decisions when priorities change, including when to cut, pivot, or stop work that evidence says will not deliver the outcome.
  • Shape new concepts and rethink existing areas: Take new products, features, and concepts from idea to adoption, and rebuild existing areas when the current approach no longer serves clients. Make scope decisions with incomplete information, adjust requirements as evidence comes in, and say no without stalling the team.
  • Eliminate manual preparation and validation work: Map how clients prepare, reconcile, and validate data today. Identify the repetitive, error-prone steps and design product capabilities (automation, rules-based checks, AI-assisted workflows) that remove them. Quantify the impact in hours saved, errors prevented, and cycle time reduced.
  • Apply AI responsibly in the product: Partner with engineering to identify where AI adds measurable client value. Define the guardrails a regulated tax environment requires: accuracy, auditability, explainability, data security, and clear points for human review. Before AI work starts, set accuracy thresholds, test datasets, and evaluation criteria with engineering so the team knows what “good enough to ship” means.
  • Use AI to work more efficiently: Use AI to draft and refine Features, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and release notes; analyze usage data and client feedback; and explore the codebase to understand current behavior before writing requirements.
  • Run the backlog in an agile framework: Write clear backlog items with testable acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps or Linear. Lead refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and sprint demos. Identify and manage dependencies across teams.
  • Make insight-driven decisions: Use product analytics, support case trends, and client research to prioritize. Back major roadmap decisions with data, and define and review adoption KPIs within 90 days of each release.
  • Own the client experience end to end: Partner with the escalation owner assigned to your scrum team to understand what clients are reporting about your product, prioritize client issues, and write actionable work items for bugs and enhancements. Validate fixes through user acceptance testing, and apply Corptax UX standards so experiences stay consistent across products.
  • Drive awareness and adoption with go-to-market: Work closely with the go-to-market, Product Marketing, and Marketing teams from concept through launch. Use their view of pipeline strength, demo feedback from sales engineers, and account manager feedback on the product and adoption to shape priorities. Build awareness for new products, features, and concepts, and bring client and market feedback back into the backlog so every release is positioned, adopted, and measured.
  • Communicate with clarity: Present roadmap, progress, and risks to clients, sales, and executives. Review client-facing communication for accuracy and tone, and raise missed commitments early with a recovery plan.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

  • 5+ years of recent product ownership or product management experience, or tax and accounting experience with direct involvement in software delivery
  • Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in daily work, with concrete examples of a manual, repetitive process you automated or eliminated and the measured result
  • Ability to break a complex workflow into discrete steps, identify which steps can be automated or validated by rules, and write requirements for them
  • Experience taking a new product, feature, or concept from idea to adoption, or rethinking an existing area, with requirements that changed as evidence came in
  • Working knowledge of AI limitations (accuracy, hallucination, data privacy) and judgment on when human review is required
  • Working knowledge of agile methodologies and backlog tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or Linear
  • Comfort working with data: Excel, basic SQL, and product analytics tools
  • Effective communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and executives
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, manage time, and deliver on commitments, and to make the call to cut, pivot, or stop work when the evidence says so

Preferred:

  • Corporate tax experience (provision, US or international compliance, Pillar Two)
  • Experience with workflow and data automation tools such as Power Automate or Alteryx
  • Comfort reading code or navigating a repository (GitHub) to understand system behavior
  • Experience building reusable AI workflows, prompt libraries, or agents

What success looks like in your first year:

  • You own a Now/Next/Later roadmap for your product area with success metrics defined for every “Now” item
  • You have shipped at least one capability that removes a manual preparation or validation step for clients, with the time saved measured
  • You use AI to accelerate backlog creation: your “Now” backlog is refined and ready for the team to build, and you work ahead to shape “Next” and “Later” items into Features before each PI
  • Your team delivers at least 90% of committed “Now” items each PI, and you cut, pivot, or stop work early when evidence shows it will not deliver the client outcome

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Kafka Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in distributed systems, event streaming, and platform engineering, including extensive expertise with Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. The ideal candidate will architect, deploy, and manage enterprise-scale streaming platforms that power mission-critical, real-time data processing across the organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kafka internals, platform automation, security, observability, and cloud-native infrastructure, along with the ability to mentor engineering teams and define enterprise event-streaming standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and manage highly available Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments supporting enterprise-scale event-driven applications.
  • Design Kafka cluster topology, broker configuration, partitioning strategies, replication, capacity planning, and performance optimization for high-throughput workloads.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Design and manage Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and event streaming pipelines for real-time data integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation frameworks to provision and manage Kafka infrastructure.
  • Design and implement High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, failover, and cross-region replication strategies.
  • Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and Confluent monitoring tools.
  • Optimize cluster performance, troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term platform improvements.
  • Support Kafka deployments on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or managed cloud services including AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), and Confluent Cloud.
  • Collaborate with application developers, data engineers, DevOps, SRE, and enterprise architects to establish event-driven architecture standards and best practices.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, establish platform governance, perform code reviews, and mentor engineers on Kafka development and operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years of hands-on Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Kafka internals, including partitions, replication, brokers, ISR, consumer groups, offset management, and performance tuning.
  • Extensive experience implementing Kafka security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and real-time event streaming architectures.
  • Experience implementing High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), multi-cluster replication, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Python, Bash, or Go, along with Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and distributed tracing solutions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Confluent Certified Administrator or Confluent Certified Developer certification.
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or similar operators.
  • Hands-on experience with managed Kafka services including AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), or Google Cloud Managed Kafka.
  • Experience with stream processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Spark Structured Streaming, or Apache Beam.
  • Knowledge of data governance, schema evolution, metadata management, and data lineage for streaming platforms.

raw.excerpt: Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions.
raw.description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.

As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof:

  • Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona.
  • Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales.
  • Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners.
  • Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards.
  • Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging.
  • Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events.
  • Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end
  • Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions.
  • A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates.
  • Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts.

You’ll really stand out if you have:

  • Familiarity with digital identity standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, ISO mDL, NIST 800-63) or KYC/AML compliance.
  • Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise.
  • Experience with developer- or platform-led motions alongside enterprise sales.

Position logistics:

    Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time

  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit

  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!

It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. raw.description:
About us:

PurposeMed is a Canadian-founded healthtech company established in 2019 with a mission to improve access to complex care for underserved communities. We’ve combined our clinical roots with a drive to scale, and now our exceptional team provides specialized care to thousands of patients every month.

PurposeMed consists of Freddie, our complex care business unit, and partner pharmacy network, Affirming Care Pharmacy.

  • Freddie improves sexual health through education, prevention, and treatment with a focus on the LGBTQ2S+ community. As the #1 rated PrEP provider in North America, we’re proudly dismantling barriers to sexual healthcare for patients across both Canada and the USA.
  • Affirming Care Pharmacy provides discreet, specialty prescription delivery across North America. Operating from six central hubs—Calgary, Mississauga, and Toronto in Canada, and Los Angeles, New York City, and San Antonio in the US—the team provides patients with an integrated, end-to-end healthcare experience.

We are proud to be ranked #2 on Deloitte’s 2024 list of Canada’s 50 fastest-growing tech companies and recognized as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures for two consecutive years. Driven by a strong mission, our team is passionate about making healthcare accessible to those who need it most—and we make sure to have fun along the way!

Permanent, full-time opportunity

Location & Schedule: Remote (Canada), Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm Mountain Time

Though we have an office based in Calgary, this is a remote position that is open to candidates across Canada. PurposeMed's office is located on the unceded and traditional territories of the peoples of the Treaty 7 region in Southern Alberta, which includes the Blackfoot First Nation tribes of Siksika, the Piikuni, the Kainai, the Stoney Nakoda First Nations tribes of Chiniki, Bearspaw, and Wesley and the Tsuut’ina First Nation. The city of Calgary is also homeland to the historic Northwest Métis and to Métis Nation of Alberta, Region 3.

Who we hope to find:

PurposeMed is looking for a bilingual (English/Spanish) Client Solutions Specialist to join the team! This role will focus on supporting Freddie, the #1 rated PrEP provider in North America. As the first point of contact for PurposeMed's existing and prospective clients, you'll be responsible for delivering an amazing support experience. That means the bar does not just equal a resolved ticket; it is a patient who feels heard, who understands what happens next, and who leaves the interaction more confident in their care than when they arrived.

In this role, you’ll make an impact by:

Delivering Exceptional Patient and Stakeholder Support

  • Responding to incoming support tickets promptly and professionally, providing solutions or escalating issues as necessary
  • Speaking with patients and other key stakeholders over the phone to ensure a speedy resolution to their questions
  • Maintaining clear and friendly communication with patients and the Clinical team, ensuring a positive customer experience
  • Striving to achieve high customer satisfaction ratings through attentive and helpful experiences
  • Documenting Client Experience interactions and resolutions accurately, so the next person picking up that patient has what they need
  • Flagging friction you notice in the queue, so recurring patient pain points get surfaced rather than just resolved

Collaborating and Following Best Practices

  • Following established SOPs, along with privacy and healthcare compliance requirements, in every interaction
  • Communicating status and blockers clearly and on time, keeping your lead informed without being asked
  • Collaborating with team members to address common issues and share insights

Contributing Beyond the Support Queue

  • Taking on tasks such as writing and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) or Help Center articles, refreshing macros and templates, or supporting a process change
  • Regularly contribute to team initiatives with direction, support, and guidance from your Team Lead
  • Participating in training sessions to enhance your knowledge of our products and services

We need someone who has:

  • Fluency in Spanish, both written and verbal
  • A high school diploma or equivalent, although a post-secondary degree or relevant certification is a plus
  • 1+ years of experience in customer service
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with patients, the Clinical team, and team members
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a strong willingness to learn
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
  • Availability to work additional shifts (including some statutory holidays and weekends) to provide necessary coverage for patient needs, with time-in-lieu offered once completed

It would also be great if you have:

  • A basic understanding of healthcare and technology concepts
  • Experience in technical support
  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Experience working in a distributed team environment

Compensation:

  • $52,000 - $56,000 CAD a year
  • The compensation listed above refers to a yearly base salary that may vary depending on a candidate's relevant qualifications, knowledge, competencies and work experience, and other factors including market conditions. Base pay is just one aspect of our total rewards at PurposeMed—see our other exciting benefits below!

Our Hiring Process:To best set you up for success, here’s what you canexpect after you apply

  • Application ReviewOur hiring team carefully reviews each application to understand how your skills and experience align with the role. We aim to respond within 14 days of receiving your application. In most cases, we’re much quicker—but as a small team that reviews every application personally, it can take a little longer when we’re hiring for high-volume roles.
  • Take-Home Assignment (1-2 hours)If your application aligns strongly with the role, you’ll be invited to complete a short take-home assignment that reflects the type of work you'd complete in this role. This helps us understand your approach to practical daily work and helps us assess certain skillsets early in the process. Please note: completing the assignment does not guarantee progression to the next stage of the process.
  • Initial Interview with a Recruiter (45 minutes)On our first call, you’ll meet with a member of our Talent Acquisition team for a high-level conversation about your background, interests, and alignment with the role and our mission. This also provides an opportunity for you to ask your initial questions about PurposeMed and the role.
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager and Team Lead (1 hour)In this conversation, we’ll dive deeper into the role and your relevant experience, while also exploring the core competencies needed for the position and how you could contribute to the team.

Do you think you could be our next Client Solutions Specialist? We look forward to seeing your application!

Why you should join us:

  • Be part of a team of great people who don’t take themselves too seriously. While we’re serious about the problems we solve, we believe in having fun along the way.
  • Make an impact, every single day. We’re providing compassionate, affirming care to many people who have never received the proper support before.
  • Be confident in bringing your whole self to work. Inclusivity is core to how we take care of our patients, our teammates, and ourselves. We create spaces that are safe and affirming.

What we’re offering (based on full-time, permanent roles in Canada & the USA):

Along with the benefits below, we offer additional programs and supports designed to help you feel your best—both at work and outside of it.

  • Work flexibly within a team that’s remote friendly; we believe that work should fit around your life*
  • 20 vacation days and a team that will remind you to use them!
  • Annual winter break closure
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision care from your first day of work—we cover 100% of your premiums, with coverage available for dependents
  • 8 health/sick days
  • Extended mental health coverage
  • $20,000 of lifetime coverage for gender-affirming care and procedures (Canada)
  • $500 learning fund to use towards courses and other professional development
  • Our unique People Potential program, in which you'll partner with your manager to identify opportunities to grow and achieve your full potential

If you are looking for a place that sparks your creativity, helps others, and will push you to be your best, then you’ll love PurposeMed.

PurposeMed is committed to being an equal-opportunity employer, and we highly encourage those from excluded and marginalized communities to apply. This includes groups such as (but not limited to): Indigenous, Black, and racialized communities, trans and non-binary, LGBTQ2S+, disabled, and HIV-positive people. You don’t have to check every single box above. If the job description gets you excited and you think you could contribute your expertise to our team—we hope you’ll apply!

*Most of our roles are performed virtually from home across Canada and the USA. Team members working onsite at Affirming Care pharmacies do need to be physically present.

Aperçu du rôle

Lorsque les radiologues reçoivent le bon examen au bon moment, les patients obtiennent des réponses plus rapidement. À titre de Développeur/Développeuse Logiciel Senior au sein de l’équipe InteleOrchestrator, vous développerez les solutions intelligentes et infonuagiques qui rendent cela possible en optimisant les flux de travail en radiologie pour les fournisseurs de soins de santé à travers le monde.

Vous serez responsable du développement complet de fonctionnalités, de la conception jusqu’au déploiement en production dans AWS. Vous contribuerez également à l’orientation technique de l’équipe et participerez à l’amélioration continue de la qualité, de la sécurité et de la performance des solutions dans un environnement réglementé.

Votre réussite se traduira par la livraison de logiciels fiables, évolutifs et sécuritaires qui réduisent la charge de travail clinique et permettent aux professionnels de la santé de consacrer davantage de temps aux patients.

Principales responsabilités

  • Concevoir, développer et prendre en charge des services infonuagiques évolutifs et performants ainsi que des interfaces Web modernes sur AWS en utilisant une architecture basée sur les microservices. Assurer le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la conception au soutien en production.
  • Contribuer à l’orientation technique de la plateforme en participant aux décisions d’architecture, à l’évaluation de nouvelles technologies et à la définition de la feuille de route technique d’InteleOrchestrator.
  • Améliorer la qualité et la fiabilité des solutions en intégrant les tests automatisés, les pipelines CI/CD, les pratiques d’observabilité et les normes de sécurité à chaque livraison.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, UX et Cliniques afin de transformer les besoins d’affaires et les besoins cliniques en solutions concrètes respectant les normes de données en santé (HL7, DICOM) et les exigences réglementaires.
  • Accompagner et soutenir les autres développeurs par l’entremise de revues de code, du partage de connaissances et du mentorat technique afin de favoriser une culture d’apprentissage continu au sein de l’équipe.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, incluant au moins 3 ans dans le développement et le déploiement d’applications Web full stack en environnement de production.
  • Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience pratique avec les services AWS tels que EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3 et ECS/EKS.
  • Maîtrise de Kotlin et de Go, ou de langages équivalents, avec une solide compréhension des principes de programmation orientée objet et fonctionnelle.
  • Expertise dans la conception de microservices à l’aide de Spring Boot ou d’un cadre de développement équivalent, appuyée par une solide connaissance de PostgreSQL ou de Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Expérience dans le développement d’interfaces Web avec Angular ou React.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes Agile utilisant Gradle, Git et des pratiques modernes DevOps dans des environnements Windows et Linux.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience avec les normes de données en santé telles que HL7 et DICOM, ou expérience dans le développement de logiciels pour d’autres industries réglementées (FDA, FAA ou équivalent).
  • Expérience avec C# ou .NET Core.
  • Familiarité avec jOOQ ou des couches d’abstraction de bases de données similaires.
  • Expérience pratique avec des plateformes d’observabilité telles que Datadog ou New Relic.

Job Purpose :

The Manager-Security Assurance role is integral to Mashreq Global Services' Information Security Group (ISG). This role is responsible for strengthening the security posture of modern applications, APIs, cloud-native platforms, and AI-powered systems. The successful candidate will integrate security throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), securing applications and APIs, implementing DevSecOps practices, and governing the secure adoption of Artificial Intelligence technologies.

Key Responsibilities for the Role

Conduct intrusive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on Applications and APIs.

Assess security risks associated with AI-powered applications, LLM integrations, AI agents, and RAG architectures.

Automate security tasks to ensure continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes are secure and efficient.

Utilize advanced attack techniques and tools to simulate real-world cyberattacks, assess security gaps, and recommend mitigation actions.

Design, implement, and maintain secure APIs and application security practices within the development lifecycle, integrating security testing tools at every stage.

Collaborate with development and operations teams to ensure the incorporation of security controls early in the software development process.

Perform security audits and code reviews to identify security flaws in the development pipeline.

Identify and evaluate security risks related to software deployments and automation processes.

raw.title: Social Media Manager
raw.excerpt: At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do.
raw.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Within our Teacher Education Ecosystem, including Moreland University, we connect with aspiring and current educators, alumni, and school leaders to support their professional journeys. Social media helps us build authentic relationships with these audiences and connect them with valuable resources and opportunities.

Come Build What’s Next

We’re looking for a Social Media Manager to lead and grow the organic social media presence of Colibri Group’s Teacher Education Ecosystem. This person will shape how our brands show up across social channels, bring educator-focused stories and campaigns to life, build engaged communities, and use performance insights to support awareness, qualified traffic, leads, and applications.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful ownership of social strategy, day-to-day content production, community engagement, social measurement, and the management of our existing influencer program. As a general guide, approximately 50% of the role is content creation, 25% is social strategy, and 25% spans analytics, reporting, and influencer-program work. The balance will shift with campaigns and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone who has managed social media on behalf of a company, organization, or agency client and understands what it means to collaborate with a marketing team and be accountable for KPIs. You should be equally comfortable developing a channel plan, filming and editing a short-form video, speaking on camera, tailoring content for different audiences, engaging with followers, and explaining what the performance data says to do next.

Important distinction: This is a professional social media management position, not an influencer, brand ambassador, or personal-content-creator opportunity. You will manage Moreland University's owned social channels and work with external influencers as partners; you will not be hired to promote our brands primarily through your own personal accounts.

What You’ll Do

  • Own organic social strategy and editorial planning: Build audience-specific strategies and content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels. Prioritize Instagram and TikTok for educator audiences, tailor LinkedIn content for school leaders and alumni, and explore authentic, non-promotional participation in relevant Reddit communities. Translate wider Marketing initiatives into platform-native campaigns
  • Create content hands-on, with a strong emphasis on short-form video: Personally concept, script, film, edit, caption, and publish videos; appear confidently in talking-head content and social live events. Independently produce graphics, carousels, stories, and copy using tools such as Canva, collaborate with the Graphic Designer on brand consistency, and develop social assets to promote guides, events, and podcasts (without hosting the podcast)
  • Build and serve engaged communities: Manage organic social accounts day to day, including comments, DMs, tags, audience conversations, and admissions-related questions that need routing to the appropriate team. Proactively identify educator and school-leader stories and opportunities for meaningful engagement, not merely one-way posting
  • Measure performance and continually improve results: Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement, video performance, website traffic, leads, guide downloads, and applications attributable to organic social. Use reporting, experiments, and audience insights to refine creative decisions and channel priorities; demonstrate how social contributes to integrated marketing goals
  • Manage influencer partnerships and collaborate across Marketing: Oversee existing external creators, including briefs, content review, approvals, deliverables, renewals, payment coordination, budgets, and ROI. Recommend when to expand, adjust, or pause partnerships. Partner closely with content, design, and paid media colleagues; direct management of paid advertising is not part of this position. Occasionally support events and content opportunities requiring travel

What You’ll Bring

  • Professional organizational social media experience: Approximately 2–4 years managing organic social accounts for an employer, organization, or agency client, with personal ownership of deliverables and accountability for KPIs. Managing only your own personal influencer accounts does not meet this requirement; additional relevant professional experience is welcome
  • Proven creation and on-camera skills: Direct experience independently planning, filming, editing, and publishing compelling short-form video for a brand, plus the ability to appear on camera and support live social content. Strong social copywriting and hands-on Canva, Capcut, or comparable design skills are also expected
  • Demonstrated growth and analytical judgment: Evidence that you have grown audiences, not solely maintained existing accounts; ability to explain the KPIs you owned, results you achieved, and changes you made based on data. Familiarity with engagement, website traffic, lead or application attribution, and testing is valuable
  • Audience-focused collaboration and execution: Experience adapting tone, formats, and channels for distinct audiences; engaging communities through comments and DMs; and working within a marketing team to manage a busy editorial calendar, multiple priorities, and cross-functional projects
  • Required professional portfolio: Include an accessible portfolio link or relevant work samples showing organizational/client accounts, short-form videos you personally produced, and ideally measurable outcomes. Redacted or anonymized case studies are welcome for confidential work. Education/edtech experience, previous influencer-program coordination, Reddit knowledge, a related bachelor's degree, and familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or ClickUp are helpful but not required. Occasional travel may be necessary

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool below is not required. We care more about your ability to create strong work, manage the process, and make decisions from results than about checking specific software boxes.

  • Social channels: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and Reddit or other educator communities
  • Video creation: CapCut or comparable filming and editing workflows. The team is open to effective tools you already know and use
  • Design and production: Canva, Capcut, and brand templates or design review with an in-house Graphic Designer
  • Scheduling, analytics, and collaboration: Sprout Social or comparable social management and native analytics tools; ClickUp or similar project-management platforms
  • Measurement and improvement: Reporting dashboards, campaign tracking, tests, performance reviews, and thoughtful use of AI for ideation, research, repurposing, or productivity while maintaining originality and brand standards

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own the organic social presence of a mission-driven education ecosystem and shape how our brands show up online
  • Create original, video-first content and tell relevant stories for teachers, future educators, alumni, and school leaders
  • Grow priority channels such as Instagram and TikTok while testing thoughtful community opportunities, including Reddit
  • Collaborate with content, design, and marketing colleagues while retaining autonomy over day-to-day creative execution
  • Connect creative work to measurable engagement, leads, and applications while helping evolve an established influencer-partnership program

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants with relevant experience in education, edtech, consumer brands, nonprofit or mission-driven organizations, agencies, and other environments where they have managed professional social channels, served distinct audiences, and delivered measurable results.

However, this position does require professional responsibility for an organization’s or client’s social presence, hands-on short-form video creation, comfort contributing on camera, and the ability to assess performance against KPIs. If your experience has primarily been creating content for your own personal influencer accounts, without managing an organization’s or client’s channels and results, this role is unlikely to be the right match.

A professional social media portfolio or relevant work samples must be included with your application to be considered. Please share a working link to campaigns, social accounts, video examples, or case studies that demonstrate your direct work and impact. If your work is confidential, you may submit redacted or anonymized case studies and examples that respect client or employer requirements.

If you enjoy creating content yourself, collaborating within a marketing team, using data to make it better, and helping real communities connect with an education brand, we would love to hear from you.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; your application is reviewed by a human on the Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. Recruiter Conversation: An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition about your professional social media background, interests, expectations, and fit for this position

2. Hiring Manager Conversation: A deeper conversation with the Senior Director of Marketing, including review of your work, approach to short-form video, audience segmentation, strategy, and results

3. Team / Cross-Functional Conversation: A conversation with team members, focused on collaboration and the capabilities relevant to day-to-day success in this role

4. Final Conversation and Decision: A final conversation with the team. For finalists, there may be an optional opportunity to connect with additional content teammates. Talent Acquisition will share details and preparation expectations throughout the process.

Application deadline: Tuesday, October 20th, 2026.

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

Summary

The Small Engine Technician is responsible for maintaining and repairing small engines used in outdoor power equipment, such as lawnmowers, chainsaws, and snow blowers. This role includes diagnosing mechanical issues, performing routine service, and providing support to customers both in person and through remote or virtual consultations. The technician advises customers on necessary repairs or maintenance, ensures that equipment operates according to manufacturer specifications, and maintains detailed service documentation to support both in-shop and virtual service interactions. Candidates must have a modern smartphone with an active internet connection to efficiently manage orders and assignments through the company app. Proficiency in navigating mobile applications, digital platforms, and app-based workflows is essential for seamless task execution and communication.

Compensation ranges from $37,440 to $62,400 per year, based on experience and availability.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnose mechanical issues in small engine-powered equipment (e.g., lawnmowers, chainsaws, snow blowers).
  • Perform routine maintenance, including oil changes, air filter replacements, spark plug inspections, and carburettor cleanings.
  • Repair or replace faulty components such as belts, spark plugs, and fuel systems.
  • Provide customers with clear explanations of necessary repairs and maintenance recommendations.
  • Document service work performed and ensure accurate records are kept for each job
  • Ensure all equipment meets manufacturer specifications and operates at optimal performance.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment while adhering to safety protocols
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment while adhering to safety protocols. Stay current with new small engine technologies and repair methods.

raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to join our Majors West team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Create and deliver technical product presentations to prospective customers
  • Gather customer technical requirements to ensure proposed solutions will meet customer goals and needs
  • Lead product evaluations and custom product configurations
  • Design evaluation test plans with customers and guide the process to successful outcomes

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner and your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, allowing you to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver who seeks out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are customer-obsessed and build deep empathy for the customer to anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems.
  • You are resilient and adaptable, viewing change as an opportunity and maintaining composure and focus in high-pressure situations.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Network Systems integrator
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent working experience
  • Proven cybersecurity and networking technical background with hands-on experience in network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, and firewalls

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Industry standard certifications such as CISSP, CCNA, Network+, CCNP, CCIE, or Security+
  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Data Engineer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade data platforms, scalable data pipelines, and distributed data processing systems that support analytics, business intelligence, and machine learning initiatives across multiple business domains. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle, from translating business and analytical requirements into robust data architectures, to developing reliable ETL/ELT pipelines, to deploying cloud-native data solutions and supporting them throughout their operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in data engineering, distributed computing, cloud data platforms, and database technologies, combined with strong hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, business analysts, software engineers, solution architects, DevOps engineers, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, reliable, and governed data platforms that directly support strategic business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of professional experience designing, developing, and supporting production-grade enterprise data engineering solutions, ETL pipelines, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of data structures, database design, distributed computing, data modeling, ETL/ELT methodologies, data warehousing concepts, and large-scale data architecture principles.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, Java, and enterprise data engineering frameworks used to build scalable, high-performance data processing solutions.
  • Hands-on, production-level experience designing and operating batch processing, streaming data pipelines, data lakes, and cloud-native data platforms using technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or equivalent solutions.
  • Proven experience working with relational and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or equivalent database technologies, including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning.
  • Strong SQL skills and meaningful experience designing dimensional models, star schemas, snowflake schemas, data marts, partitioning strategies, indexing, and enterprise-scale data warehouse solutions.
  • Solid experience with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release management, infrastructure automation, and Agile software development methodologies supporting enterprise data engineering initiatives.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical thinking, debugging, root-cause analysis, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to investigate complex data processing issues methodically and implement scalable, maintainable engineering solutions.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures, real-time data streaming platforms, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Apache NiFi, RabbitMQ, or equivalent enterprise messaging and streaming technologies.
  • Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native deployment practices using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, or equivalent enterprise automation technologies.
  • Exposure to distributed systems concepts including eventual consistency, fault tolerance, distributed transactions, data replication, partitioning strategies, CAP theorem, high availability, and large-scale data processing architectures.

raw.description:
Senior IT Security Engineer - [Portugal / Spain / Poland - Remote]

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a challenging enterprise technology environment where cybersecurity, resilience and risk management are central to business operations. As a Senior IT Security Engineer, you will help shape security capabilities, strengthen protection across complex IT environments and improve how security threats are detected, investigated and resolved.

This role combines hands-on technical expertise with specialist leadership. You will influence security strategy, advise stakeholders on risk-based decisions, mentor engineers and drive continuous improvement through automation, secure architecture and effective operational processes.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

You will take a leading role across security monitoring, detection engineering, incident response and security systems engineering. Working with multiple telemetry sources and security technologies, you will investigate complex alerts, lead high-impact incidents and develop detection capabilities that improve threat coverage while maintaining high alert quality.

You will also architect, implement and support security controls, identify vulnerabilities and drive practical remediation across enterprise technology environments. A key part of the position involves designing maintainable automation and system integrations that reduce repetitive work and deliver reliable security outcomes at scale.

Beyond technical delivery, you will advise on architecture, access management and security exceptions, helping stakeholders make informed risk decisions. You will contribute to security policies and guidance, strengthen security awareness through measurable insights, manage vendor relationships and support the development of other engineers through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (Required)

  • Substantial hands-on experience in IT security engineering or security operations, including leadership of complex investigations and high-impact incident response.
  • Strong detection engineering experience across SIEM, IDS and multiple security telemetry sources.
  • Experience developing, improving and tuning security detections to increase coverage and minimise false positives.
  • Practical experience architecting, implementing and supporting security controls in complex IT environments.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security assessment and the remediation of technical vulnerabilities.
  • Ability to develop maintainable scripts, automation workflows and system integrations that improve security operations at scale.
  • Sound technical judgement when assessing security risks involving access management, exceptions, architecture and technology choices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce security policies, technical guidance and clear communications for senior stakeholders.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers, providing specialist security consultancy and developing technical documentation or knowledge-sharing resources.
  • Experience improving security awareness using metrics, data and stakeholder feedback.
  • Experience managing security vendors, including product evaluation, due diligence, account management and renewals.
  • Ability to rapidly develop expertise in unfamiliar technologies, understand emerging vulnerabilities and attack techniques, and translate that knowledge into practical security improvements.
  • A proactive, analytical and collaborative approach to security engineering and continuous improvement.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred)

  • Hands-on experience with Splunk or comparable SIEM, security monitoring and detection platforms.
  • Broader security experience across endpoint, network, identity, web security, data protection and vulnerability management.
  • Experience designing security integrations and automation across multiple platforms and data sources.
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications or equivalent demonstrable technical expertise.
  • Experience establishing detection and response metrics, improving incident management processes and developing evidence-based security awareness initiatives.
  • Experience influencing security architecture and technical direction in complex enterprise environments.

Compensation: €2,300 – €3,300/month net, depending on experience and seniority level.

raw.description:
• Listen to audio recordings and produce accurate, verbatim transcriptions in Hungarian
  • Capture not only what is said, but how it is said (including filler words, repetitions, and false starts).
  • Add speaker labels for multi-speaker recordings (2–8 participants).
  • Insert precise timestamps for text segments (within 500ms accuracy).
  • Annotate non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, or unclear audio.
  • Follow detailed project instructions and maintain high quality standards.
  • Maintain steady productivity and reliability throughout the project.
  • Native-level fluency in Hungarian, including familiarity with regional accents and informal speech.
  • Strong listening comprehension and attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce verbatim transcriptions, including stutters, repetitions, and filler words.
  • Experience in transcription, annotation, or linguistics is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using browser-based tools (training will be provided).
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Access to a laptop or desktop computer (mobile devices are not supported).
  • Reliable availability for 20+ hours per week.
  • Work anytime, provided you meet project deadlines and quality standards.
  • Tasks and overall workload may shift based on project needs.
  • Consistent availability and productivity are required throughout the assignment.
  • Payment will be based on your completed output.

Our enterprise client, a leading provider of high-quality, diverse datasets for AI model development is looking for a Hungarian Audio Segmentation and Transcription experts to support an AI training initiative aimed at improving Hungarian speech recognition models.

In this role, you will produce precise, verbatim transcriptions and review audio recordings in Hungarian Your contributions will directly help train and enhance next-generation AI speech technologies.

Work Assignment: This project focuses on transcription tasks involving both single-speaker and multi-speaker audio recordings. Tasks may vary in complexity depending on audio quality and number of speakers.

Task Summary (What to Expect)

You will listen to real audio recordings and produce precise, verbatim transcripts — capturing not just what was said, but how it was said. That means every “uh,” every repeated word, and every trailing sentence matters. Your work will include:

  • Verbatim transcription with a target of 98%+ accuracy
  • Timestamping segments with less than 500ms deviation
  • Speaker labeling for conversations with 2 to 8 participants
  • Event annotation for non-speech elements (e.g., laughter, background noise, unintelligible audio)

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users.

You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices.

You will have the opportunity to:

- Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities.

- Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation.

- Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together.

Within 1 month, you will

  • Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture.
  • Become familiar with our R&D way of working.
  • Understand the team’s processes.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm.
  • Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes.
  • Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability.
  • Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support.
  • Manage incidents and post-mortem.
  • Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads).
  • Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts.
  • Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability.
  • Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default.

The Skill Set

  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Ideally, you have worked in a tech or a SaaS company
  • You know how to run systems in production
  • Interest in platform engineering and developer experience: you like building tools that other engineers enjoy using
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, GitOps).
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
  • You have a coding background (scripting, programming)
  • Passion for automation and continuous improvement.
  • You have working proficiency in English (level B2 or equivalent)Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:

    • Our technical stack

  • Cloud: Azure Cloud

  • Container orchestration: k8s, ArgoCD

  • Infra as Code: Terraform, AnsibleHelm

  • Monitoring tool: Datadog

  • Database: MongoDB Atlas

  • Application language: Javascript

What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process:

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Lead Devops Engineer
  • Case Study to do at home and to discuss with a Devops Engineer
  • Clarification Meeting with a Devops Engineer
  • Culture-fit Meeting with our VP Engineering
  • Offer!

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Integration Platform Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Integration Platform Developer with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including extensive expertise with the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and manage enterprise-scale integration solutions while driving API strategy, event-driven architecture, governance, security, and platform modernization initiatives. This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of delivering highly scalable, secure, and reusable integration solutions while collaborating with enterprise architects, application teams, and business stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration solutions using the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform, including process development, connector configuration, and runtime optimization.
  • Architect scalable integration solutions utilizing API-led connectivity, event-driven architecture, and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop reusable integration processes, shared components, libraries, and templates to accelerate enterprise integration initiatives.
  • Build and manage RESTful APIs, SOAP services, event-driven integrations, and real-time data synchronization solutions.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage Atom, Molecule, and Atom Cloud runtimes while ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational reliability.
  • Develop custom integrations and extensions using Groovy, JavaScript, or Java where required.
  • Implement enterprise API security using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS, certificate-based authentication, and API management best practices.
  • Integrate enterprise applications including SAP, Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, ServiceNow, and other cloud and on-premises systems.
  • Design and implement event-driven integration solutions using Apache Kafka, JMS, Boomi Event Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Establish CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and observability for integration solutions.
  • Optimize integration performance, troubleshoot complex production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable integration solutions.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, perform code reviews, establish integration development standards, and mentor junior integration engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, including 5+ years of hands-on Dell Boomi AtomSphere experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Boomi AtomSphere, including process design, connectors, Atom/Molecule runtime management, and deployment strategies.
  • Strong experience developing REST APIs, SOAP services, API management, and enterprise integration solutions.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Groovy, JavaScript, or Java for Boomi customization and automation.
  • Extensive experience integrating enterprise platforms including SAP, Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, ServiceNow, and similar SaaS applications.
  • Deep understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, encryption, and API governance using OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Experience implementing event-driven architectures using Kafka, JMS, Boomi Event Streams, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps tools.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dell Boomi Professional Developer, Boomi Professional Architect, or equivalent Boomi certification.
  • Experience with Boomi Flow, Boomi DataHub, Boomi Integration, Boomi API Management, and Boomi Event Streams.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud deployment across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with other enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), or Azure Integration Services.
  • Knowledge of FinOps, cloud cost optimization, API governance, and enterprise integration best practices.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply immediately.

raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.
