raw.description:
About Sussman Law Firm, PLLC

Sussman Law Firm is a Charlotte-based firm focused on family and immigration law. We value accountability, initiative, and professional growth within a collaborative, high-performance environment. We are not your typical law firm. We are poised for aggressive growth, and we believe great work starts with a strong team.

Our Culture

Sussman Law Firm fosters an environment where employees are empowered to make a real impact in clients’ lives every day. We value accountability, ownership, and collaboration. Every team member—regardless of role—is respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally and personally. This is a high-performance environment. We work hard, hold ourselves to high standards, and take pride in doing things the right way. The work is challenging—but it is also meaningful, rewarding, and growth-oriented. If you are looking for a role where you will be pushed to grow, supported by a strong team, and make a difference in people’s lives, you will fit right in.

If you are hired, you will be part of a wonderful team of people who work hard to get the job done right the first time and take pride in the work that they do. You will be part of a team that is rewarded for their hard work. Is this going to be an easy job? No. It might be the biggest challenge of your life. However, it is our belief that anything really great is worth working hard for and that our greatest growth comes from our biggest challenges. More importantly, you will find great joy in helping people find solutions in the areas of their lives that matter most!

The Job
The Marketing Supervisor will lead and execute the Firm’s day-to-day marketing efforts while helping shape strategies that drive brand awareness, qualified leads, and growth. This role is ideal for a hands-on marketing professional with strong analytical, digital marketing, and SEO experience who can turn data into actionable strategies and measurable results.

Compensation starting at $1,500/month + Bonus Potential

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the Firm’s annual and quarterly marketing strategy, goals, priorities, campaigns, and performance targets in collaboration with Firm leadership.
  • Develop and manage the Firm’s annual marketing budget and optimize marketing spend based on cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, ROI, and other performance metrics.
  • Evaluate marketing performance and analyze data, trends, lead sources, and campaign results to identify opportunities to increase qualified leads, improve conversions, and maximize marketing effectiveness.
  • Establish marketing KPIs and benchmarks, monitor performance against established goals, and present results and actionable recommendations to Firm leadership.
  • Serve as the Firm’s primary point of contact for its SEO and digital marketing vendor and manage vendor strategy, deliverables, performance, deadlines, and results.
  • Evaluate and implement SEO strategies, including organic search performance, keyword optimization, website content, landing pages, local search visibility, and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Directly supervise the Marketing Coordinator, including establishing priorities, delegating responsibilities, providing coaching and feedback, and monitoring the quality and timely completion of work.
  • Create and manage social media and digital content, including graphics, short-form videos, employee features, client testimonials, and other content consistent with the Firm’s brand and target audiences.
  • Create, edit, and distribute the Firm’s monthly newsletter and monitor engagement and performance.
  • Oversee day-to-day marketing operations, campaigns, projects, vendors, and related initiatives to ensure timely and effective execution.
  • Ensure marketing meeting notes are documented timely and assigned action items are tracked through completion.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Portfolio showcasing the candidate's creativity in content creation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent education and/or relevant experience may be considered.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of progressive marketing experience, including digital marketing, SEO, analytics, and campaign management.
  • Prior supervisory experience required; minimum two (2) years preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and evaluating SEO strategies.
  • Experience using website and marketing analytics platforms to measure traffic, lead generation, conversions, and campaign performance.
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, or comparable digital marketing and SEO tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop dashboards, KPIs, and performance reporting for management.
  • Experience managing or working directly with outside marketing, SEO, advertising, or creative vendors.
  • Law firm or professional-services marketing experience preferred.

Key Success Factors

  • Develops, executes, and prioritizes marketing strategies and resources that support the Firm’s growth and revenue objectives and produce measurable business impact.
  • Increases qualified lead generation and uses analytics and performance data to evaluate lead quality, conversions, marketing ROI, and opportunities for improvement, proactively adjusting strategies when needed.
  • Effectively manages SEO strategy and vendor performance while strengthening the Firm’s internal SEO capabilities.
  • Provides effective supervision, coaching, accountability, and development to the Marketing Coordinator.
  • Maintains a consistent, professional, and recognizable Firm brand across marketing channels and initiatives.

The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Leidos Civil IT division is focused on innovation and solving complex technical problems spanning infrastructure operations, cybersecurity analytics, and application modernizations. We rely on a team of skilled staff capable of operating across technical domains, embracing challenges, and being adaptable to new technologies and new ideas.


This position is Telework / Remote.

Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you."

About the Role

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer supports the operation, maintenance, automation, and continued modernization of AWS and hybrid-cloud infrastructure supporting federal systems. The engineer will work alongside senior infrastructure and security engineers to implement cloud changes, troubleshoot issues, maintain infrastructure-as-code, remediate vulnerabilities, monitor system health, and improve operational processes.

This is a developmental engineering position intended for an individual with strong technical fundamentals who wants to build deeper expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, automation, networking, and security. The engineer is not expected to arrive as an expert across the AWS platform but should demonstrate technical curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies.

About the Candidate

We are specifically looking for someone who can:

  • Support AWS infrastructure including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, load balancing, DNS, and related services.
  • Implement infrastructure changes using established architecture, procedures, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Maintain and modify Terraform and/or CloudFormation configurations under guidance from senior engineers.
  • Monitor cloud resources and investigate availability, performance, configuration, and security issues.
  • Troubleshoot networking, operating system, application connectivity, permissions, DNS, and cloud-service issues.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, patching, configuration compliance, and security-hardening activities.
  • Assist with cloud migrations, modernization efforts, disaster recovery, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
  • Develop scripts and automation to reduce repetitive administrative work.
  • Maintain technical documentation, diagrams, procedures, and change records.
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Work with senior engineers to learn cloud architecture, security, networking, automation, and operational best practices.
  • Gradually assume ownership of cloud services and technical workstreams as experience develops.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems or relevant field and 1-3 years of practical experience in the field
  • Ability to obtain public trust clearance
  • Ability to independently manage assigned work, document technical activities, communicate issues, and seek assistance when appropriate.
  • Demonstrated self-initiative to build enterprise-like AWS systems and resources that align with well-architected frameworks
  • Understanding of fundamental networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, subnets, and firewalls/security groups, with the ability to apply systematic troubleshooting methods
  • Basic understanding of infrastructure security concepts such as least privilege, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and security baselines.
  • Hands-on experience building solutions with Cloudformation, Terraform, Python, or other tools

Beneficial Qualifications

  • Cloud related certifications (Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, etc)
  • Exposure to CIS Benchmarks, STIGs, or similar security and compliance frameworks

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Embedded Software Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$195,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize firmware and embedded software for next-generation connected devices, industrial automation systems, automotive platforms, medical devices, and IoT products. This role focuses on developing high-performance, real-time embedded applications that interact directly with hardware components while ensuring reliability, security, and compliance with industry standards.
You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems architects, electrical engineers, QA teams, and product managers to build embedded software solutions supporting mission-critical products deployed across enterprise and industrial environments. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in embedded C/C++, RTOS development, device drivers, communication protocols, and hardware-software integration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems.
  • Develop low-level device drivers, Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers (HAL).
  • Build real-time applications using RTOS platforms including FreeRTOS, VxWorks, ThreadX, Zephyr, or Embedded Linux.
  • Develop firmware supporting communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, BLE, and MQTT.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers during board bring-up, hardware validation, and system integration activities.
  • Optimize embedded applications for CPU utilization, memory footprint, power consumption, and boot time.
  • Implement secure firmware update mechanisms, secure boot, encryption, and hardware-based security features.
  • Develop software supporting sensors, actuators, wireless modules, and peripheral devices.
  • Debug hardware-software integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Write unit tests, integration tests, and automated validation scripts to ensure firmware quality.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and Agile development activities.
  • Support production deployments, field diagnostics, root cause analysis, and firmware maintenance.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional embedded software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Embedded C and Modern C++ for firmware development.
  • Extensive experience developing software for ARM Cortex-M, ARM Cortex-A, STM32, NXP, Renesas, Texas Instruments, or Microchip microcontrollers.
  • Strong understanding of embedded systems architecture, memory management, interrupts, DMA, timers, and peripheral programming.
  • Hands-on experience with RTOS platforms including FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, Embedded Linux, or VxWorks.
  • Experience developing device drivers and low-level hardware interfaces.
  • Strong knowledge of communication protocols including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN/CAN FD, Ethernet, USB, Modbus, MQTT, BLE, and TCP/IP.
  • Experience with Embedded Linux development, kernel configuration, and driver development is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with hardware debugging tools including JTAG, SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and serial protocol analyzers.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated firmware builds, and version control systems.
  • Strong understanding of software debugging, profiling, and optimization techniques.
  • Experience using build systems such as CMake, Makefiles, or Bazel.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices for embedded systems.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience developing software for automotive, aerospace, medical devices, industrial automation, robotics, or IoT platforms.
  • Familiarity with AUTOSAR, MISRA C/C++, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, DO-178C, IEC 62304, or other industry safety standards.
  • Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, or custom Embedded Linux distributions.
  • Knowledge of wireless communication technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Zigbee, LoRaWAN, or Cellular IoT.
  • Experience implementing secure boot, TPM integration, Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), and firmware signing.
  • Familiarity with FPGA integration and hardware acceleration.
  • Experience using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI for firmware automation.
  • Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting for test automation and manufacturing support.
  • Experience with cloud-connected IoT platforms including AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, or Google Cloud IoT.
  • Embedded systems certifications or contributions to open-source embedded projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining an embedded engineering team developing next-generation intelligent devices and connected systems supporting enterprise and industrial customers. Current initiatives include:
  • Industrial IoT gateways and edge computing platforms
  • Smart manufacturing and factory automation controllers
  • Automotive electronic control units (ECUs)
  • Medical monitoring and diagnostic devices
  • Connected consumer electronics and smart home devices
  • Wireless sensor networks and edge AI platforms
  • Embedded Linux networking appliances
  • Secure firmware platforms supporting OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates
  • High-performance embedded systems deployed across mission-critical environments
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to firmware architecture, embedded software development, hardware integration, system validation, performance optimization, and long-term product reliability for enterprise-grade embedded solutions.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

You’ll join the Client Service team in our Enterprise Fitness vertical as an Application Support Specialist, working remotely from Spain. The team provides 3rd level technical support for the Exerp Platform, our ERP for some of the largest fitness chain operators in the world, along with our web services and apps.

Our products are complex, highly customisable and built to flex around each client’s needs. You’ll work directly with our clients’ dedicated Exerp superusers and application specialists, who rely on us to solve their most critical problems quickly and well.

You will love this role if you enjoy getting to the bottom of complex technical problems and building strong working relationships with clients. The department is growing and changing, so there’s real room to develop your career with us.

Reporting into Manager of Client Services for Xplor, you’ll support our clients by:

  • Acting as a daily point of contact for clients, mainly through tickets and also in client meetings
  • Analysing and resolving complex product issues and questions, and bringing in the right internal people until the problem is solved
  • Troubleshooting technical issues and tracking down bugs alongside a team of Technical Product Analysts
  • Reporting issues directly to our Engineering teams with clear, detailed documentation
  • Joining our Major Incident response team to resolve the most urgent and critical client problems
  • Keeping the client experience at the centre of every interaction

This is a fully remote role based in Spain.

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

Required qualifications for this role:

  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Excellent written and spoken Spanish
  • Confidence engaging with clients in meetings and during critical situations
  • Experience with databases, SQL and Excel, and a genuine interest in IT
  • Strong attention to detail, patience and a structured way of working

Nice to have:

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via .

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in the country you're applying for. This applies to remote roles too. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

Interview Recording and Background Checks

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community.

We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.

raw.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points. You are organized, detail-oriented, and possess a "White Belt Mentality", always eager to learn and improve. Above all, you are a "Human" first, bringing a positive, engaged personality that strengthens our remote, transparency-first culture.

Key Responsibilities

Skills & Qualifications

Company Benefits

  • Generous paid-time-off policy

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Financial Analyst, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Finance Analyst, FP&A Analyst, MIS Analyst, Business Analyst

What would you tell a leadership team about their own business that they have not thought to ask?

On a typical day you might reconcile the weekly scorecard numbers back to Xero and HubSpot before the leadership review in the morning, work through month-end variances with the Financial Controller and draft the commentary after lunch, and send a short written note on why a revenue line moved and what you would do about it before the end of day.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture, and this role sits with the group finance function.

A company growing this fast is steered by the numbers someone puts in front of it each week. This is that seat.

About This Role

You're Contour's first Financial Analyst, and the senior of the first two India-based seats in group finance, alongside an Accountant who runs the transactional side. You own the analytical layer: the monthly reporting leadership reads, the weekly scorecard the business runs on, budget vs actual tracking, and the analysis behind decisions. You report to the Financial Controller, who owns the budgeting and forecasting, statutory reporting, management reporting, tax, and final sign-off of all financial data. Leadership decides which metrics matter; you make them measurable and reconciled, with the explanation attached.

Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you're proactive by instinct: when a number moves, you find out why, form a view, and put a recommendation in front of the people who can act on it. You don't stop at what happened, you push to why it happened and what should happen next. Second, you build reporting to run itself, so your hours go into analysis, not copy-paste.

This analytical work has so far been carried alongside other jobs, not owned by one person. You change that: the weekly and monthly rhythm leadership runs on is being set up now, and you build it.

By month three, you own the monthly reporting cycle, the weekly leadership scorecard is live with agreed definitions and targets vs budget, budget vs actual reporting is standing, and at least one of your recommendations has been acted on. What you build here becomes how Contour reads its numbers as it scales.

Where the work lives

  • Xero: actuals live here, so your reporting starts from, and ties back to, the ledger.

  • Google Sheets: the working medium for models, budgets, and reporting packs, so clean structure and formulas someone else can follow are the baseline.

  • HubSpot and Stripe: enrolment and payment data live here, so revenue analysis means joining what the CRM says with what actually settled.

  • AI tools: Claude and similar are part of how this team works, so using them to build, draft, and check analysis is expected here, not a novelty.

  • monday.com: task status moves here, and keeping yours current is how a remote team sees progress without having to ask.

What You Will Do

  • Own the monthly management reporting pack.Build it, run it on a predictable cycle, and make it the version leadership trusts: actuals from Xero, enrolment and revenue from HubSpot and Stripe, with commentary on what changed and why.

  • Run the weekly leadership scorecard.One set of numbers, agreed definitions, one source of truth, red-amber-green against targets. You keep definitions tight and figures reconciled so nobody argues whose number is right.

  • Track the business against budget.The Financial Controller owns the budget; you own how we track against it. Build the reporting, explain variances, flag material ones early with a view on what to do.

  • Analyse enrolments and revenue across the three brands.Volumes, movements, and the drivers across Contour Education, TestPrep, and MedPrep, turned into findings a non-finance leader can act on.

  • Answer the questions behind decisions.Sizing an offering, checking if a cost line earns its keep, testing an assumption in the forecast: these land with you and your recommendations go into the weekly review.

  • Automate the grunt work.Use Sheets, AI tools, and the BI layer to make recurring reports assemble themselves. The dashboarding toolkit is still being chosen; you will have a real say in it.

  • Partner for clean inputs.The Accountant keeps the ledger tight and the data team owns the sources of truth; you work with both so your numbers agree everywhere they appear.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 3 to 6 years in an FP&A, finance analyst, MIS, or business analyst role, including management reporting you built or ran yourself rather than inherited.

  • Advanced Google Sheets or Excel: you can build a model, a variance analysis, and a clean reporting layout from a blank sheet

  • Comfort pulling data out of the systems it lives in (an accounting platform, a CRM, a payments platform) and joining it into one picture that agrees with itself.

  • AI tools as a working habit: you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or similar to speed up analysis and build reporting, and can show how.

  • Sharp written English. Much of your work with the Financial Controller and leadership is asynchronous, so a variance commentary or a recommendation has to land right the first time, in writing.

  • Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on Xero, or another cloud accounting platform, on the reporting side

  • Dashboards you built in Power BI or Looker Studio that other people actually used

  • EdTech, education services, or another B2C business with recurring or instalment revenue

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • One version of the truth:any number you publish agrees with the ledger and everywhere else it appears.

  • Reports run themselves:the recurring pack lands on schedule without heroics, because you automated the assembly.
  • Ahead of the question:leadership hears why a number moved from you, before they ask.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience, and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a technical assessment, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Financial Controller, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one short paragraph on an insight you found in data that changed a decision: what you noticed, and what happened next.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreYellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

The Security Operations Engineer is the operational backbone of the Security Operations Centre (SOC). It is a fully remote, hands-on, technical role that owns three tightly integrated domains: security alert design, triaging, and automated response; cloud security posture management across EKS and AWS environments; and posture tracking and reporting.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Product & Infrastructure Security, the engineer works alongside a mature Application Security team and collaborates closely with DevOps, Engineering, and Security GRC functions. The role sits within the First Line of Defense and is expected to progressively drive down manual effort through detection-as-code and SOAR automation.

This is not a perimeter-security or scan-and-report role. The right candidate must be comfortable writing detection logic, triaging cloud misconfigurations at the infrastructure level, and owning end-to-end vulnerability remediation cycles in containerised environments.

What You'll Do

1. Security Operations

The engineer owns the full lifecycle of security detection and response inside the SOC, from signal design through to automated containment. This is the primary domain of the role.

Alert design and coverage

  • Design and maintain SIEM detection rules covering cloud, container, identity, and application layers, using both signature-based and behavioural logic
  • Map detection coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps relevant to the organisation's AWS and EKS attack surface
  • Integrate threat intelligence feeds to refresh rule logic for emerging threats and TTPs
  • Maintain a detection backlog, prioritised by risk, with defined review cadences

Alert triage

  • Daily SIEM alert triage following defined response timing standard
  • Classify, investigate, and resolve security signals;
  • Reduce false-positive rates through structured tuning cycles, with documented rationale for rule changes
  • Maintain triage runbooks for key production detection rules

Automated response workflows (SOAR)

  • Build and maintain SOAR playbooks for common alert types including IAM anomalies, misconfiguration alerts, exposed secrets, and container runtime events
  • Automate enrichment steps (asset lookup, threat intel correlation, ownership resolution) to reduce analyst time-to-context
  • Document automation logic and maintain version control for all playbooks
  • Measure and report automation coverage rate as a standing KRI

2. Cloud Security Posture Management

Cloud posture management is the infrastructure-facing domain of the role, covering vulnerability management, identity governance, and configuration and change control. AWS EKS and Serverless resources are the primary environments.

Vulnerability management

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability triage process for cloud and container environments, prioritising findings by business impact using CVSS scoring, asset criticality, and exploitability context
  • Manage EKS-specific vulnerability coverage: base image currency, workload scanning results, pod security standards compliance, and node group patching cadence
  • Coordinate remediation with engineering teams by opening well-scoped tickets, tracking progress, and escalating SLA breaches
  • Maintain MTTR and SLA compliance data by severity tier
  • Oversee CSPM posture score targets; triage new Critical findings within defined SLA windows

Identity and access governance

  • Review and approve IAM policy changes, enforcing least-privilege and flagging over-permissioned roles or service accounts
  • Execute scheduled IAM hygiene reviews: unused credentials, stale access keys, overly broad policies, and cross-account trust boundaries
  • Govern workload identity configurations in EKS, ensuring service accounts carry only the permissions required
  • Support the secrets rotation program and enforce zero hardcoded credentials across the estate

Configuration and change management

  • Review and approve cloud network security changes: security group modifications, network ACL changes, and routing updates
  • Own container image security: base image update cadence, scanning results review, and image ownership classification
  • Investigate and remediate misconfiguration alerts surfaced by CSPM tooling within defined SLA windows
  • Maintain a configuration baseline for critical cloud resources and flag drift

3. Posture Tracking and Reporting

The engineer is the primary data owner for security posture metrics across both SOC and cloud domains. Reporting outputs feed executive dashboards, GRC compliance evidence, and quarterly risk reviews.

KRI data collection

  • Collect and maintain Key Risk Indicator data across all three KRA domains on defined cadences
  • SOC KRIs: MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledge), MTTR, false-positive rate, automation coverage rate, detection coverage score
  • VM KRIs: Critical/High finding counts, SLA compliance rate by severity, MTTR by tier, overdue remediation count
  • Posture KRIs: CSPM score, under-protected asset count, misconfiguration closure rate, IAM hygiene score, log source coverage

Recurring control reviews

  • Execute infrastructure security control checks on weekly (CSPM critical findings), monthly (IAM hygiene, secrets rotation status), and quarterly (posture benchmark, detection coverage review) cadences
  • Produce structured findings reports for each review cycle, flagging control failures for escalation

Reporting

  • Provide SOC and cloud posture metrics, including trends, at the required reporting cycles
  • Support external audit and due diligence processes by providing evidence artefacts

4. Others

  • Co-own the shared vulnerability backlog (infrastructure side) with the Application Security team, ensuring consistent prioritisation methodology across domains
  • Serve as the infrastructure and identity SME for the AppSec team during application security assessments and architecture reviews
  • Own infrastructure containment during incidents that span application and infrastructure layers, working alongside AppSec for root cause analysis
  • Provide infrastructure, identity, and network security review for new third-party integrations prior to deployment
  • Collaborate with the Security GRC function on control evidence and compliance mapping, particularly for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and across different time zones
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in security operations, cloud security, or infrastructure security engineering
  • Hands-on AWS security experience: IAM policy design, virtual network architecture, cloud-native security services, CloudTrail, GuardDuty
  • Kubernetes and EKS security experience: pod security standards, network policy enforcement, workload identity, image scanning
  • SIEM operations: alert triage, detection rule authoring (signature-based and behavioural), log analysis and correlation
  • Vulnerability management: CSPM tooling, risk-based prioritisation, CVSS scoring, SLA framework operation
  • IaC security: ability to read and review Terraform or CloudFormation for misconfigurations
  • Incident response: investigation, containment, and post-incident reporting
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FinTech, payments, banking, or crypto preferred)
  • Ability to author and tune detection rules without relying on vendor-supplied defaults
  • Structured written communication for triage reports, post-incident write-ups, and stakeholder metrics
  • Ability to coordinate remediation across engineering teams without direct authority
  • Comfort operating in a lean team where domain boundaries are broader than in large enterprise security functions
  • Professional certifications: AWS Security Specialty (highly valued)
  • Experience with CSPM and SIEM platforms: Datadog, Wiz, Orca Security
  • Experience with secrets management platforms: AWS Secrets Manager
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA
  • Scripting ability in Python or Bash for detection-as-code and operational automation
  • Experience with SOAR or workflow automation platforms
  • Understanding of cryptocurrency or blockchain security considerations
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
  • AI tooling familiarity and interest in applying AI to operational workflows

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Regulated, multi-geography environment with real-world impact on financial inclusion
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Ownership of the SOC and cloud security posture function from day one, in a high-growth FinTech environment
  • Broad domain exposure: detection engineering, cloud security, container security, incident response, and compliance
  • Collaborative team culture with a mature AppSec function and strong leadership support

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contractTesting Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care.

Job Summary:

Health information coding is the transformation of verbal descriptions of diseases, injuries, and procedures into numeric or alphanumeric designations. The coding process reviews and analyzes health records to identify relevant diagnoses and procedures for distinct patient encounters. Coders are responsible for translating diagnostic and procedural phrases utilized by healthcare providers into coded form procedure codes that can be utilized for submitting claims to payers for reimbursement. A joint effort between the healthcare provider and the coder is essential to achieve complete and accurate documentation, code assignment, and reporting of diagnoses and procedures.

Job Duties:

  • Reviews the content of the medical record for hospital and professional inpatient or outpatient records to identify principal diagnosis, secondary diagnoses and procedures performed that explain the reason for service being provided or the admission and patient severity and comply with standard provider coding regulations.
  • Carefully details review of documents such as laboratory findings, radiology reports, various scan reports, discharge summary, history and physical, consultations, orders, progress notes and other ancillary services treatment records needed to ensure all pertinent diagnoses and procedures are recorded.
  • Translates all diagnostic and procedural phrases utilized by healthcare providers into coded form using procedure codes as required.
  • Using the Encoder software program, determines the codes for all diagnoses and procedures.
  • Determines their sequencing to legally maximize reimbursement.
  • Assigns the appropriate DRG.
  • Assigns codes based on hospital and professional coding guidelines, Coding Clinic directives, federal regulations, CCI coding initiatives, CPT Assistant or other standard coding guidelines Queries physicians as needed to clarify documentation within the patient’s record to facilitate complete and accurate coding.
  • Reviews coding guidelines on an annual basis and makes recommendations for change to improve coding and data management.
  • Communicates to Coding Quality and Professional Manager any new diagnoses, procedures, technologies, etc. documented within patient records to ensure that appropriate diagnosis and procedure codes are selected and incorporated into hospital and professional coding guidelines.
  • Updates and corrects historical file data by completing and submitting claim action reports per the PHC4 quarterly report.

Work is typically performed in an office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

Digital Marketing Manager – End-to-End Lead/Funnel

Work From Home | Full-Time | AU Hours

About the Role

We are hiring a highly strategic and hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to support a fast-growing AI Certification Body (Not-for-Profit).

This is a blank canvas role where you will build, execute, and optimize the entire digital marketing function—from strategy through to execution.

This is not just social media management. You will own the full customer journey, from awareness to conversion.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the end-to-end digital marketing strategy
  • Map full-funnel journeys: Awareness Consideration Conversion Retention
  • Identify growth opportunities across all digital channels

Funnel & Systems

  • Build and optimise landing pages, lead magnets, and conversion funnels
  • Develop email nurture sequences and lifecycle marketing flows
  • Implement CRM and automation systems (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Klaviyo)

Paid Advertising

  • Plan, launch, and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, and LinkedIn
  • Manage budgets, creative testing, and performance tracking (ROAS, CPA, CPL)

Email & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Build and manage campaigns, newsletters, and automated flows
  • Segment audiences and improve engagement across the customer lifecycle

Social Media & Content

  • Oversee content strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok (if relevant)
  • Collaborate with content creators to produce high-performing short-form and educational content

SEO & Analytics

  • Own SEO roadmap including keyword research, on-page optimisation, and content planning
  • Track and report on traffic, leads, conversions, and ROI
  • Continuously optimise campaigns and funnels based on performance data

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end digital marketing
  • Proven track record in building funnels, running paid ads, and scaling campaigns
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys, CRO, and performance marketing
  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, and LinkedIn Ads
  • Experience with email platforms (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Familiarity with CRM/automation tools (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Experience with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, etc.)
  • Experience in the service-based industry, preferably from a Tier 1 company, with hands-on experience in sales funnels and lead generation﻿

What We're Looking For

  • A builder mindset — able to create systems from scratch
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
  • Ability to work independently and take full ownership
  • Focus on outcomes, performance, and growth

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in education, certification, or not-for-profit sectors
  • Exposure to AI or emerging tech industries
  • Strong copywriting skills (direct response and brand)
  • Experience managing remote teams or freelancers

What Success Looks Like

  • A fully built and optimised marketing engine
  • Consistent lead generation and conversion growth
  • Clear reporting dashboards and actionable insights
  • Scalable systems across all digital channels

Why Join Us?

  • Full ownership of marketing strategy and execution
  • Opportunity to build systems from the ground up
  • Work with an innovative AI-driven organisation
  • Supported by OutsourcedIn's infrastructure and team

Final Note

If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this role isn't for you.

We're looking for someone who understands:

  • Strategy
  • Systems
  • Execution
  • Growth

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase is looking for an experienced SEC Reporting Manager to join our Financial Reporting organization. Reporting to the Director, SEC Reporting, this role will serve as a key owner of Coinbase’s external reporting process, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, earnings release support, and related audit and control activities. This role will coordinate with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, and external auditors, while also helping drive improvements to our reporting infrastructure, Workiva processes, and disclosure operating model in a fast-moving public-company environment.

What you’ll do:

  • Own major portions of the end-to-end 10-Q / 10-K / 8-K production cycle, including calendar management, drafting coordination, review workflows, tie-outs, and final filing support.
  • Lead complex disclosure areas, translating accounting, business, and operational changes into clear and decision-useful external reporting.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, and external auditors to resolve judgmental issues and deliver timely, accurate filings.
  • Drive structural improvements to SEC reporting, including Workiva, source-data flows, supporting templates, review controls, and process documentation.
  • Support audit requests, quarterly board / audit committee materials, and other ad hoc analyses tied to external reporting.
  • Coach and elevate junior team members through review, process discipline, and operating best practices.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 9+ years of relevant experience in SEC reporting, external reporting, or public-company financial reporting, including recent hands-on ownership of 10-Q / 10-K processes.
  • CPA or equivalent required.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, SEC disclosure requirements, SOX controls, and public-company reporting mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex disclosures, coordinating auditors, and managing cross-functional stakeholders under tight deadlines.
  • Experience with Workiva (Wdesk), NetSuite, and spreadsheet-based analytical review in a controlled reporting environment.
  • Strong written judgment, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to improve ambiguous or evolving processes.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Job Summary

The Senior Advisor, GCF Pipeline and Capture Lead will lead the development and advancement of CRS' global Green Climate Fund (GCF) pipeline, from early opportunity identification and country positioning through concept note and full funding proposal readiness and submission. The role provides enterprise leadership for donor intelligence, capture management, pipeline governance, proposal review processes, resource planning, and organizational learning. It ensures that country programs and proposal teams have the tools, guidance, staffing structures, and decision-making processes required to systematically advance a focused, competitive, and well-managed GCF pipeline. Note that project specific design, technical leadership, and proposal drafting remain with designated country teams, technical leads, proposal coordinators, and specialist advisers. While the main focus of this role is on GCF, the role will also focus on possible opportunities across other Climate funds and present to the unit Director the possible positioning and resources which need to be allocated beyond GCF.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • With CFSU director co-lead agency position for GCF, FRLD (Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage) and GEF (Global Environmental Facility).
  • Lead intelligence gathering and analysis, strategic priorities, programming directions, investment trends, country opportunities, and relevant funding windows.
  • Lead and maintain CRS' global GCF pipeline, including capture plans, opportunity identification, prioritization, sequencing, and readiness for anticipated GCF Board submission windows. Identify pipeline risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and staffing gaps early and elevate decisions to the appropriate leadership level.
  • Work with country programs, regional teams, GREM (Global Resources, Engagement and Mobilization), PIQA (Program Impact and Quality Assurance), and CFSU colleagues to clarify the path from early project ideas through concept note and funding proposal stages.
  • Clarify the respective roles and responsibilities of the RFP (regional focal point) or proposal coordinator, technical lead, country program, reviewers, CFSU, and other contributing teams. Be accountable for filling roles internally and externally. Onboard all CRS staff and consultants working on the pipeline, coordination and technical support.
  • Establish a structured approach to capturing learning from GCF engagement, including feedback from GCF, NDAs, reviewers, partners, consultants, country programs, and proposal teams.
  • Ensure lessons from project idea pitches, concept notes, funding proposals, reviews, and external engagement are documented and fed back into capture strategies and pipeline processes.
  • Maintain a coherent suite of resources, including Climate Funds 101, GCF Donor 101, Project Idea Note review guidance, value proposition tools, capture templates, pipeline dashboards, roles and responsibilities dashboards, and Concept Note and proposal tools and templates.
  • Establish regular feedback loops with country programs, coordinators, technical leads, reviewers, and leadership to ensure guidance remains practical and responsive to operational needs.
  • Develop and manage consultant rosters for GCF pipeline and proposal needs, including writers, proposal coordinators, technical specialists, economists, financial experts, safeguards specialists, and other priority functions.
  • Maintain regular communication with leadership and colleagues so that pipeline status, upcoming decisions, resource requirements, and emerging issues are visible and addressed early.
  • Represent the pipeline perspective in relevant internal planning and coordination forums and support engagement with GCF regional teams, NDAs, partners, and peer organizations as appropriate.
  • Maintain a network of external contacts with peer organizations, technical experts, consultants and Climate Fund technical staff and represent CRS in key engagements with these stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficient in MS Office packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), and Web Conferencing Applications
  • Demonstrated experience transferring knowledge to diverse audiences through training, mentoring, and other formal and informal methods
  • Excellent writing, synthesis, facilitation, and judgment, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.
  • Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect donor intelligence, organizational capabilities, country priorities, and pipeline decisions.
  • Strong process leadership and the ability to create clarity across complex, multi-team workflows.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication, negotiation, facilitation, and representation skills.
  • Ability to build the capacity of colleagues and partners through practical guidance, coaching, and learning processes.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, identify risks early, and bring decisions to resolution.
  • Strong commitment to collaboration, continuous improvement, and usable institutional knowledge.

Required Languages: Oral and written fluency in English is essential. The ability to work and communicate in French or Spanish is preferred. Arabic is a plus.

Travel:Travel may be required for strategic country engagement, capture planning, donor engagement, proposal readiness, and relevant meetings, in line with the needs of the GCF pipeline and CRS travel policies. Must be willing and able to travel 25%.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

About the job

PagerDuty is seeking a Sales Development Representative to join our diverse, customer-focused team. In this role, you will report to our Manager, Commercial Sales Development. Your focus will be on generating new business opportunities through inbound and outbound motions among a group of accounts that fit our ideal customer profile. Daily responsibilities include researching, prospecting, qualifying leads, and initiating conversations to help build a pipeline for our Account Executives.

Do you have a proven track record of success working with new logo accounts? Are you skilled in prospecting, organizing, and enjoy achieving victories? This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who is passionate about technology, has experience in lead generation for complex solutions, and can provide consultative guidance in early sales conversations. If you possess excellent time management skills, understand how to qualify opportunities effectively, and are energized by building pipeline, we would love to talk to you!

Key Responsibilities

Value Selling – Focus on highlighting the unique PD value and benefit our products and services can provide to a customer. It goes beyond just features and price, emphasizing the impact and solutions that address the customer's specific needs or challenges.

  • Understanding the problems and focus areas of your stakeholders and effectively communicating how PagerDuty will support and address those company priorities
  • Aligning use cases with the appropriate service offering
  • Quickly adapting to the Command of the Message (COM) selling model and employing solution selling/customer-centric sales method

Sales Effectiveness – Establishing, overseeing, and maintaining genuine connections with prospects

  • Encourages positive conversations between new or potentially new customers and sales teams, leading to solutions aligned with the customer's strategic vision
  • Ensuring complete customer satisfaction in all interactions

Sales Execution – Ensuring that one’s own and others’ work and information are complete and accurate; careful preparation for meetings and outreach; following up with others to ensure that agreements and commitments have been fulfilled to contribute to PagerDuty's long-term strategic initiatives

  • Prospecting - calling and emailing executives at senior levels across various lines of business using scaled techniques and tools
  • Documenting key qualification details, including use case, purchase timeframes, and next steps (MEDDICC Framework)
  • Qualifying inbound and outbound opportunities to support Account Executives
  • Prioritizing accounts and allocating appropriate outreach efforts

Basic Qualifications

  • 1-2+ years strong background in lead generation and prospecting
  • 1+ year experience with common SaaS software tools:
    • SFDC
    • Outreach / Salesloft
    • Tableau
    • DemandBase / 6Sense

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven ability to quickly gain trust with senior leaders, internal and external
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills
  • Passion for cloud technologies

The base salary range for this position is 46,800 - 60,400 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions: Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. ICF is seeking a Substation Civil Structural Engineer with experience performing electric utility substation design engineering and reviews. Rust Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Rust Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $145,000–$205,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.
  • Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.
  • Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.
  • Design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Optimize CPU utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.
  • Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.
  • Build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on Rust development experience in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
  • Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.
  • Strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock-free programming concepts.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and high-performance backend applications.
  • Strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.
  • Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases such as Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience integrating distributed messaging systems including Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Pulsar.
  • Strong debugging, profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building distributed systems supporting high-throughput financial, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or telecommunications platforms.
  • Familiarity with Rust web frameworks including Axum, Warp, Rocket, or Actix Web.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes Operators or cloud-native infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic libraries, TLS, secure communications, and certificate management.
  • Experience building command-line tools and systems utilities using Rust.
  • Familiarity with C/C++ interoperability through Foreign Function Interface (FFI).
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or participation in the Rust community are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise-scale applications across cloud environments. Current initiatives include:
  • High-performance API gateway and service mesh components
  • Real-time event streaming and data processing pipelines
  • Distributed job scheduling and workflow orchestration services
  • Cloud-native platform services deployed on Kubernetes
  • Secure authentication and identity management infrastructure
  • Infrastructure automation and systems observability platforms
  • High-availability backend services processing millions of requests daily
  • Enterprise monitoring, telemetry, and reliability engineering solutions

This is a highly technical engineering role where you will contribute to architecture, implementation, performance optimization, deployment, and operational excellence for large-scale production systems.

raw.description:
About Mosaic:

Mosaic Pediatric Therapy provides clinic-based and home-based ABA therapy for children with autism across North Carolina and Virginia. We are growing quickly, and we run an increasingly sophisticated internal technology ecosystem (e.g., custom applications, AI-assisted operational tools, agentic workflows, and a modern Azure-based Lakehouse) that supports clinical operations, billing, credentialing, and analytics. These systems handle protected health information (PHI) and sit in workflows where accuracy and compliance are non-negotiable. As adoption of AI coding tools like Claude Code accelerates across the organization, we need a senior technical operator who can help transform a growing collection of internal tools into a scalable, secure, and well-engineered platform ecosystem.

About The Role:

    This is a stewardship role with broad responsibility for agentic software engineering, data engineering, and DevOps. You will help establish the technical foundation for how internal software is built, deployed, integrated, secured, and maintained across the company.

    Part of the role involves helping operationalize software engineering standards, supporting internal builders using AI-assisted development tools, improving reliability and deployment practices, and helping design scalable infrastructure for a rapidly expanding internal application portfolio. But equally important will be owning and extending the data pipelines that underpin developed applications and that feed into our Azure Fabric Lakehouse environment.

    This is a highly cross-functional role that works directly with the VP of Data Science, Director of IT, and operational leadership across the business. The ideal candidate enjoys moving fluidly between architecture discussions, debugging production issues, designing data models, reviewing pull requests, deploying infrastructure, and helping non-traditional developers build high-quality internal tools safely and effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and support the company's internal technical platform: Help establish engineering standards and operational practices for a growing ecosystem of internally developed applications and AI-enabled tools. Support internal builders using Claude Code and related AI development environments by providing guidance around source control, modular design, testing, deployment, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Improve software operations and production reliability: Help implement production-grade operational practices across internal systems, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, deployment workflows, environment management, uptime management, and post-incident review processes.
  • Own and extend the data platform: Maintain and expand the company’s Azure Fabric Lakehouse architecture across bronze, silver, and gold layers. Build and monitor ingestion pipelines, improve reliability and observability, resolve data quality issues, and help translate business questions into well-modeled reporting datasets and semantic layers.
  • Support internal analytics and operational stakeholders: Work directly with operational, billing, credentialing, and clinical leadership to support reporting requests, operational tooling, and scalable self-service data access.

What We're Looking For:

    Required

  • 4+ years building and supporting production software systems, data platforms, or cloud infrastructure
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git workflows, testing, modular architecture, debugging, and code review
  • Strong SQL and Python skills
  • Experience building and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Comfort operating across both application engineering and data engineering domains
  • Experience supporting or deploying internal operational software systems
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development workflows and tools such as Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar environments
  • Understanding of security and governance principles for regulated or sensitive data environments
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to independently own technical systems end-to-end

    • Nice to Have

  • DevOps or infrastructure-as-code experience
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • SQL Server administration experience
  • Experience in healthcare, ABA, EHR/EMR, claims, or other regulated environments
  • HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, SOC 2, or related compliance exposure

Why This Role Matters:

    This role is foundational to how Mosaic scales technology over the next several years. You will help shape the technical standards, infrastructure, operational practices, and engineering culture that support the next generation of internal software and AI-enabled systems across the company. Rather than joining the company with a narrowly scoped job function, you will help build the operational backbone for how technology gets built and maintained organization-wide.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • PTO and paid holidays
  • Remote-first flexibility
  • Equipment and tooling support
